M SungrowModbusWebClient · sungrow-go WebSocket client · modbus-mqtt.rs sungrow-winets crate Tesla Powerwall 2 / Powerwall+ / Powerwall 3 gatewayTesla is healthy but narrowing local access: since firmware 25.10.0 TEDAPI is reachable only by joining the gateway's own Wi-Fi AP (community-sourced). C · P4 Phone joins the gateway's own Wi-Fi access point using the sticker password and reads TEDAPI protobuf. PW3 v1r wired mode needs key registration.phone-direct; protocol code-only Huge installed base; TEDAPI and v1r exist only in pypowerwall code, and firmware keeps shrinking the path. PW2 REST is already documented (vloschiavo): link, don't spec.Caveat: Read-only telemetry only: reserve, operating-mode and islanding writes are grid-tied control. Never commit the sticker password, serials or DIN. L pypowerwall (TEDAPI, v1r, notice) · vloschiavo PW2 local API docs · Powerwall-Dashboard (PW3 via AP) SolarEdge SetApp inverters (local /web/v1 protobuf API)Financial distress: removed from S&P 500, Energy Storage division closed Nov 2024, CEO change Dec 2024. 2025-2026 status unverified. B · P3 /web/v1 HTTP endpoints return protobuf on SetApp units with CPU 04.x boards; recent firmware disables them. SunSpec Modbus TCP is the durable path.phone-direct; protocol community-documented A large installed base and a struggling vendor. Firmware updates are closing the protobuf API, so an archival spec is needed while units still expose it.Caveat: Do not copy solaredge-local's .proto files. Read-only telemetry only; no power-limit or grid-profile writes. Link Modbus, do not spec it. M solaredge-local endpoint catalogue · solaredge-modbus-multi integration APsystems ECU-R / ECU-R Pro / ECU-B / ECU-C microinverter gatewaysNo shutdown known; not checked independently. (unverified) C · P3 LAN TCP 8899 to the ECU with APS...END text queries. Inverter controls only on ECU-R Pro (2162+) and ECU-C. Ethernet recommended.phone-direct; protocol code-only A major microinverter brand alongside the existing Enphase and Hoymiles items; the local query protocol lives only in Home Assistant integration code.Caveat: Firmware can block features. Inverter-off, power-limit and zero-export writes affect the grid; keep defaults read-only. Separate from EZ1. M HAEdwin APsystems ECU reader · ksheumaker original ECU-R integration Daly Smart BMS (H/K/M/S series; legacy J/T/A/U/W/ND)July listActive BMS maker; no shutdown or subscription found (unverified). C · P3 Phone-direct BLE to BMS advertising as DL-; Modbus-style 0xD2 frames give cells, temperatures, SOC, current, MOSFET/balance state. Legacy series use 0xA5.phone-direct; protocol community-documented Second most common Chinese pack BMS, on the candidates page and unspecced; a clean spec separating the 0xD2 Modbus and legacy 0xA5 generations fills a gap.Caveat: Do not transcribe the vendor-like register sheet in esphome-daly-bms docs; write from observed behaviour. Flag MOSFET writes as pack-safety risks. M esphome-daly-bms · batmon-ha Daly connectors · BMS_BLE-HA (Daly DL- devices) EPEVER Tracer / XTRA charge controllers (HN BLE, eBox-BLE-01)EPEVER (Beijing Epsolar) appears to be an active manufacturer; no shutdown or subscription found (unverified). C · P3 Phone-direct BLE, no pairing: Modbus RTU with CRC16 written to 0x2B14, notifications on 0x2B10, max 8 registers per read. RS485 shares the register map.phone-direct; protocol code-only Common budget MPPT/PWM controllers and a sibling to the Renogy BT spec; the register map is known but the BLE transport is code-only in one small project.Caveat: eBox-BLE-01 may use FFE0/FFE1 instead; needs owner verification. Flag setting writes such as charge voltages, which can damage batteries. S epever-ble integration and CLI · epevermodbus RS485 register library Goal Zero Yeti Wi-Fi power stationsNRG Energy acquired Goal Zero in September 2014; current ownership and app/cloud status are unverified. C · P3 Wi-Fi HTTP JSON on port 80, via the Yeti's own access point (direct mode) or the LAN: /state, /sysinfo, /wifi, /join; no auth documented.phone-direct; protocol community-documented Common RV and home-backup line whose phone app talks to the unit's own access point; the API is written up in one blog post and a small library (community-documented).Caveat: Limit to X-series and Yeti 3000 until newer-model endpoints are checked; add a security note on unauthenticated /factory-reset and /password-set. S Yeti local Wi-Fi REST write-up · tkdrob/goalzero library · Home Assistant Goal Zero integration Huawei SUN2000 inverters / LUNA2000 batteriesNo shutdown or subscription evidence found for this large, active vendor. (unverified) C · P3 Modbus TCP via the inverter's own access point or SDongle/EMMA; RS485 RTU wired. Writes need the installer login; one TCP client at a time.phone-direct; protocol code-only Huge European and Asian installed base, phone-direct through the inverter's access point. Base register map reportedly a vendor PDF (link it); installer login and file extension are code-only.Caveat: Scope writes to battery mode and charge control; leave grid-protection settings out. Warn that a phone session locks out other Modbus clients. L huawei-solar-lib library · huABus Modbus-MQTT bridge JK-BMS (Jikong) and Heltec/NEEY active balancersJuly listActive Chinese BMS maker; current JK-PB models are supported by community tools; no shutdown or subscription found. (unverified) C · P3 Phone-direct BLE GATT, same path as the vendor app: 20-byte commands with CRC return settings, cell and device-info frames. BMS software 6.0+; UART alternative.phone-direct; protocol community-documented Most common DIY LiFePO4 BMS, flagged on the 2026-07-30 candidates page and still unspecced; consolidates JK02, JK04, JK-PB and balancer variants beside the JBD spec.Caveat: Existing write-up covers only JK02_32S well. Cite, never copy, the vendor PDFs and captures in esphome-jk-bms; warn about MOSFET-toggle writes. M esphome-jk-bms BLE protocol write-up · esphome-jk-bms component · batmon-ha JK support SMA Sunny Boy / Tripower / Island (Speedwire, WebConnect, SMA Bluetooth)Active. SMA reported H1 2026 sales growth (2026-08-13) and opened a Gigawatt Factory (2026-09-17). C · P3 Speedwire (SMAdata2+ over UDP) and legacy SMA Bluetooth read directly; WebConnect HTTPS JSON on the inverter. No Sunny Portal needed.phone-direct; protocol code-only A major EU inverter brand with no spec in the repo. Speedwire and Bluetooth framing exist only in SBFspot's C++ source.Caveat: Split into Speedwire and WebConnect specs. Sunny Tripower X is out of scope. Bluetooth is Classic RFCOMM, not iOS-reachable. Read-only. Legacy SMA Bluetooth is Classic RFCOMM and waits on a schema value. L SBFspot reader · pysma WebConnect library Tesla Wall Connector Gen 3 (local HTTP API)Tesla is active. Community report: firmware 26.2+ ignores external current limits during active charging (community-sourced). C · P3 Unauthenticated HTTP JSON on the LAN (vitals, lifetime, version, wifi_status): energy, voltage, per-phase current, temperatures, connection and contactor state. No known local control.phone-direct; protocol code-only A very widely installed home EVSE whose local JSON API is read-only and known only from library code; a spec records fields and states what cannot be controlled.Caveat: Document the read-only API only; no instructions for exceeding the installer-set breaker limit. Confirm the /api/1 prefix on a live unit. S tesla-wall-connector Python library · Home Assistant integration page

docs.title: Lighting, switches, shades, desks and hubs
docs.text: Device and vendor status Risk Local path Why a spec, and the catch Effort Public work AwoX / EGLO connect Bluetooth (Telink) mesh lightsEGLO appears to be moving its connect range to Zigbee and Wi-Fi, leaving BLE mesh as legacy (inferred). The HA integration is paused. B · P4 Phone sends AES-encrypted Telink mesh commands over BLE GATT to any node; no hub. Mesh credentials are downloaded once from the AwoX account.phone-direct; protocol code-only European BLE-mesh lights with fragmenting apps and a stalled open integration. The phone talks to the mesh directly, and one Telink family spec could cover GE Cync too.Caveat: Describe the phone-direct path, not the ESP32 hub. Fully offline, account-free enrolment is unsolved; say so. M home-assistant-awox component · ESPHome AwoX BLE mesh hub · awoxble2mqtt-api .NET reimplementation Somfy myLink (Synergy API, Wi-Fi to RTS bridge)Somfy reportedly lists myLink as obsolete and points new installs at TaHoma; per a third-party integrator, not confirmed on a Somfy page. B · P4 LAN JSON-RPC over TCP port 44100, app-set SystemID as the auth param. Scenes and up/down/stop; assumed state, since RTS motors are one-way.phone-direct; protocol code-only An obsolete bridge in front of a large RTS shade base; its local API is what TaHoma lacks, and lives only in client code. The repo's first shade hub.Caveat: SystemID is a weak shared secret sent in plaintext; re-check 'obsolete' against a Somfy page. RTS radio side is out of scope. S somfy-mylink-synergy Python library · Home Assistant Somfy MyLink · node-somfy-synergy (archived) Linak DPG desk controllers (IKEA IDÅSEN)Linak and IKEA active; whether IDÅSEN is still sold was not sourced (unverified) C · P4 BLE GATT direct from phone to desk controller, the same path as the Linak Desk Control app; Home Assistant integration is Local Push.phone-direct; protocol code-only A mass-market IKEA desk whose BLE protocol, including DPG init and the REFERENCE_INPUT move, is scattered across small codebases; complements the Jiecang/Uplift candidate.Caveat: Only IDÅSEN is confirmed; DPG1C, DPG1M and iMovr Lander are community-reported. Document the one-connection-at-a-time behaviour. S linak-controller reference notes · linak-controller (idasen-controller) · Home Assistant Idasen integration Philips Hue Bluetooth bulbs (bridgeless BLE)Signify is active; the standalone Hue Bluetooth app was removed from app stores (Hueblog, 2023-12-08), folded into the main Hue app. C · P4 Phone bonds to the bulb over BLE GATT for power, brightness, colour temperature and XY colour, with notifications. Needs pairing mode or factory reset.phone-direct; protocol code-only Millions of Hue bulbs are sold without a bridge, but the repo covers only the bridge REST API. The BLE path is phone-direct and undocumented by Signify.Caveat: Document the bonding requirement for encrypted characteristics, and that some Bluetooth adapters cannot hold the connection. S HueBLE Python library · hue-ble-ctl GATT inspection tool · Home Assistant Hue BLE Sonoff / eWeLink LAN mode and DIY modeITEAD/Sonoff is active; SonoffLAN warns the local protocol is not always stable and not all devices support it (community-sourced). C · P4 mDNS _ewelink._tcp discovery, HTTP POST to /zeroconf/ on port 8081, AES-128-CBC keyed from the devicekey fetched once from the eWeLink account.phone-direct; protocol code-only One of the largest cheap-switch ecosystems. DIY mode is vendor-documented, but the encrypted LAN mode stock devices use lives only in SonoffLAN code.Caveat: Link ITEAD's DIY docs rather than respec them. State the one-time cloud devicekey dependency; paraphrase the crypto, never copy local.py. M SonoffLAN LAN transport code · ITEAD DIY Mode protocol docs · SonoffLAN HA integration TP-Link Tapo and KLAP-era Kasa plugs and bulbsTP-Link is active and keeps changing auth: KLAP on Kasa 2021, KLAP v2 on Tapo 2023, TPAP in newer firmware (community-sourced). C · P4 LAN HTTP with UDP 20002 discovery. KLAP two-step handshake, then encrypted /app/request; older Tapo uses securePassthrough. TPAP may need a cloud-issued certificate.phone-direct; protocol code-only Probably the largest-volume plug and bulb line here. The repo's Kasa spec leaves KLAP/Tapo out of scope, and the handshakes exist only in python-kasa code and PRs.Caveat: KLAP v1 hashes with MD5, v2 with SHA1 over both seeds. Describe default credentials by role only. Mains relays: segment the network. M python-kasa KLAP transport docs · python-kasa transports and discovery · Reverse engineering the Tapo (2020) NEEO Brain + RemoteControl4 shut down NEEO cloud services in Q1 2021; exact day unverified. (community-sourced) A · P3 HTTP REST on Brain port 3000 from the phone: rooms, recipes, scenarios, macros, forward-action webhooks and an IR blaster endpoint; Brain found by mDNS.phone-direct; protocol code-only Orphaned premium hub-remote that still runs locally; its API is known only from openHAB binding code and forum posts. Fits beside the Harmony Hub spec.Caveat: Adding new devices needs the dead cloud database or custom drivers. Don't require rooting; describe openHAB paths as observed, don't copy source. M neeo2021onward FAQ · openHAB NEEO binding docs Broadlink RM4 IR/RF blasters (RM4 mini, RM4 pro, RM4S)July list · note: research-notes/broadlink-sp-plugs.mdActive; vendor site still lists universal remotes, plugs and lighting with live support (checked 2026-09-23). No shutdown or subscription found. C · P3 Wi-Fi LAN UDP port 80: broadcast discovery, AES-128-CBC auth, per-client key, then learn and send IR/RF. No cloud after Wi-Fi join.phone-direct; protocol code-only Most common IR/RF bridge for legacy AV, fans and shades. RM4 framing exists only in python-broadlink code; the repo's research note covers only SP plugs.Caveat: protocol.md covers RM2 only. Newer firmware or the app's 'lock device' option may block local auth (not re-verified); document unlocking. M python-broadlink protocol.md (RM2-era) · python-broadlink library Casambi Bluetooth lighting networks (EVO and Classic)Casambi Technologies Oy is active, claiming more than 8M Casambi Ready products sold; no acquisition mentioned. C · P3 Phone connects over BLE GATT to any node, sending encrypted frames the network relays. Needs a one-time cloud key fetch and 'Bluetooth control' enabled.phone-direct; protocol code-only A widely deployed BLE lighting mesh built into many luminaire brands, where the phone app is the controller; the protocol exists only in one alpha library.Caveat: Enrolment needs the Casambi cloud once; flag that. Start with EVO; Classic firmware, only in the drschnalli fork, is phase two. L casambi-bt Python BLE library · casambi-bt-hass fork (Classic support) Delta Dore Tydom gateways (Tydom 1.0/2.0, Tywell, Tyxal+ hub)Active. Delta Dore still promotes the Tydom app and partner ecosystem; no end-of-life or cloud-change notices found. C · P3 LAN HTTP Digest auth then a WebSocket to the gateway, with pushed updates. Uses the gateway password or physical-button pairing; no account.phone-direct; protocol code-only The repo has no French coverage. Tydom's capability-driven local protocol exists only in two community clients.Caveat: Base the spec on the capability model, not model lists. The mediation.tydom.com cloud relay is optional and outside the local spec. M hass-deltadore-tydom-component · tydom2mqtt bridge Elgato Key Light family (incl. Key Light Air MK.2)Corsair/Elgato is active. Key Light Air MK.2, released 2026-07-23, replaced plain HTTP with mutual-TLS WebSocket JSON-RPC (community-sourced). C · P3 Classic models: unauthenticated HTTP on port 9123 under /elgato with mDNS discovery. MK.2: mutual-TLS WebSocket JSON-RPC needing an Elgato-signed client certificate.phone-direct; protocol community-documented A common creator and home-office light with a simple phone-direct API Elgato never documented; the new MK.2 protocol exists only in one issue thread.Caveat: Never include or explain extracting Elgato's CA key from the desktop app; MK.2 credential is out of scope (DMCA 1201 question). S Unofficial Key Light API docs · Key Light Mini firmware RE · MK.2 mTLS JSON-RPC issue Hunter Douglas PowerView Gen 3 shades (direct BLE)Hunter Douglas is active; Gen 3 API docs were not public as of July 2022. hdpv_ble archived 2026-08-02 (community-sourced). C · P3 Phone writes 13-byte frames to each shade's BLE service 0xFDC1, AES-CTR with a fixed per-home key and zero IV. Key must be captured once.phone-direct; protocol community-documented Premium shades whose app talks BLE directly to each shade. The protocol is only partly implemented across archived and read-only repos; consolidate it before it scatters.Caveat: Document key-acquisition routes but ship no key material. Do not copy the openHAB keystream code (different licence). M Gen 3 BLE PROTOCOL.md · hdpv_ble HA integration (archived) · hacs_hunter-douglas-blind integration IKEA DIRIGERA hub, local REST and WebSocket APICurrent product from a healthy vendor, released October 2022; IKEA promises at least three years of hub support and local operation afterwards. C · P3 HTTPS REST on 8443 via mDNS; pressing the hub's button within about 60 s grants a bearer token; a WebSocket stream carries state events.phone-direct; protocol code-only Successor to TRÅDFRI whose LAN API is code-only across four community SDKs. Spec what Matter lacks: native pairing, event stream, scenes, IKEA-specific attributes.Caveat: The firmware's bundled OpenAPI file is a vendor asset: never copy, fetch or paraphrase it. Self-signed cert needs pinning or trust-on-first-use. M Leggin/dirigera Python client · lpgera/dirigera TypeScript client · DirigeraClient Java client Jiecang BLE standing-desk controllers (UPLIFT, IKEA MÅLOMRÅDE, rebadges)July listJiecang is an active OEM still listing the JCP35N-BLT Bluetooth receiver. Corporate health unverified. C · P3 Phone-direct BLE GATT to the desk's receiver, bridged to the control box UART. Services seen: 0xFE60, 0xFF00 (V3) and 0xFF12.phone-direct; protocol community-documented A strong phone-direct BLE target alongside Linak; the IKEA MÅLOMRÅDE link widens the base. A consolidated profile would cover the new V3 layout.Caveat: Protocol is already community-documented; link librick for opcode tables. Describe stop and anti-collision behaviour. One-central limit needs bench confirmation. M uplift-ble protocol reference · MÅLOMRÅDE V3 GATT map Meross plugs, switches, bulbs and MSG100 garage openernote: research-notes/meross-msg100.mdActive; meross.com lists plugs, garage openers, Matter and Thread products (checked 2026-09-23). App v3.41.1 current on 2026-08-07. C · P3 Signed HTTP POST of JSON to the device's /config endpoint (md5 sign header). Device key from the account, or provision locally via device AP.phone-direct; protocol community-documented A research note confirms the local path but no validated spec exists. A platform spec would cover a whole product line whose docs are scattered across three projects.Caveat: Scope as a platform spec, not MSG100-only. The door can close without line of sight; the door sensor is not a safety interlock. M arandall/meross protocol write-up · MerossIot protocol inspection · meross_lan HA integration Motionblinds Bluetooth motors (CMD-03)Active; vendor says Bluetooth motors connect directly with no bridge, and publishes no BLE motor protocol. C · P3 BLE GATT direct from phone to motor: open, close, stop, position and tilt. No bridge or cloud; status is read on connect or poll.phone-direct; protocol code-only BLE shade motor sold under many retail blind brands, phone-direct. The protocol exists only in the motionblindsble library code.Caveat: Derive command framing and any encryption or time-sync step from code; the fixed-key AES recollection is unverified. Eve motors excluded. M Home Assistant Motionblinds Bluetooth docs · motionblindsble Python package Rademacher HomePilot / Start2Smart (DuoFern) bridgeActive as Delta Dore Rademacher GmbH after a merger; HomePilot still promoted, no discontinuation notice. C · P3 LAN HTTP REST to the HomePilot or Start2Smart bridge, optional hub password; the bridge drives DuoFern and Zigbee devices by radio.phone-direct; protocol code-only Large German base of shutter and belt-winder actuators behind one hub whose REST API exists only in pyrademacher (code-only).Caveat: Endpoints and password hashing must come from library code, not the README. DuoFern RF protocol is a separate topic. Class C, not rescue. M pyrademacher Python library · homeassistant-rademacher integration Tuya BLE devices (Fingerbot, Fingerbot Plus, CubeTouch)July listTuya is active; the claim that Tuya publishes only a device-side BLE SDK was not checked (unverified). C · P3 BLE GATT service 0xFD50, session encrypted with keys from device uuid and local_key. One-time cloud fetch of the key, then fully local.phone-direct; protocol code-only Framing and session setup are already in tuya-bt-soil-tester; the gap is the Fingerbot and CubeTouch DP maps, which exist only in HA forks.Caveat: Cross-link the soil-tester spec rather than duplicating it. State the one-time cloud enrolment plainly; paraphrase SDK behaviour, never copy constant tables. M ha_tuya_ble HA integration · tuya-ble-sdk Python SDK · Fingerbot BLE proof of concept Hunter Douglas PowerView Hub (Gen 1/2) and Gen 3 GatewayHunter Douglas is active; a Gen 3 swagger was promised in July 2022 but its release is unverified (community-sourced). C · P2 Gen 1/2 hub: unauthenticated LAN HTTP REST under /api (shades, rooms, scenes), positions 0-65535. Gen 3 gateway: separate local REST with push.phone-direct; protocol community-documented Hub companion to the Gen 3 BLE entry. Gen 1/2 has one community write-up; the Gen 3 gateway API is scattered across aiopvapi, HA and openHAB code.Caveat: Check whether the Gen 3 swagger shipped and the aiopvapi PDF's provenance first; if vendor-made, link rather than restate. M indigo-powerview Gen 1/2 API write-up · aiopvapi (Gen 3 support) · openHAB hdpowerview binding

docs.title: Climate, air, water and outdoor
docs.text: Device and vendor status Risk Local path Why a spec, and the catch Effort Public work Eurotronic Comet Blue BLE radiator thermostat (and rebadges)Eurotronic is active, but Comet Blue was missing from its product list on 2026-09-23. No formal end-of-life notice found. B · P4 Phone-direct BLE with a PIN, the same path the vendor app uses. No gateway needed.phone-direct; protocol code-only A common EU BLE thermostat with ten years of community clients but no written protocol. Sibling of the eqiva-eq3-ble-trv spec; covers Sygonix, Xavax and Silvercrest rebadges.Caveat: PIN default is 0 or 000000 depending on source; verify on-wire encoding. Do not assume Comet Zero Bluetooth shares the protocol. S im-0 cometblue library · rikroe Comet Blue component · HA core Comet Blue integration Gecko Alliance in.touch 2 spa moduleThe new Gecko App and cloud require replacing in.touch 2 with in.touch 3 hardware; no end-of-life date given (checked 2026-09-23). B · P4 On the LAN straight to the in.touch 2 home transmitter, reading and writing the spa-pack structure with no cloud (geckolib, GeckoLib.NET).phone-direct; protocol code-only Protocol built from packet captures and exists only as code. Owners are stranded on a legacy path the vendor has cut off. The repo has no spa coverage.Caveat: Do not reproduce geckolib's per-pack tables (likely vendor-derived). Port 10022 is only the simulator's; confirm real port and discovery. M geckolib, built from packet captures · GeckoLib.NET in.touch2 UDP port Mitsubishi Electric Kumo Cloud Wi-Fi adapter (PAC-USWHS002-WF-1/WF-2)Kumo Cloud being replaced by the Comfort app; June 2025 rollout broke local credential retrieval, restored in pykumo 0.4.0 (February 2026) (community-sourced). B · P4 A one-time KumoCloud V3 call fetches each adapter's credentials; then all reads and commands are local HTTP with a locally computed token.phone-direct; protocol code-only The repo's thermostat dud note wrongly calls Kumo cloud-only. The local token scheme lives only in pykumo and should be recorded before the V3 credential endpoint changes.Caveat: Setup needs one cloud call per adapter; document credential and token derivation so saved credentials survive a shutdown. WF-2 on Comfort unverified. M pykumo local adapter library · hass-kumo, V3 breakage and fix · Pragmatic Steward Comfort rollout post tado V3+ Internet Bridge / Smart AC Control V3+ (HomeKit)tado's help centre (2026-01-27) caps REST API use at 100 requests/day without an Assist subscription and 20,000/day with one. B · P4 HAP-IP on the LAN: read temperature/humidity, set target and mode per zone. Bridge allows one HomeKit controller; unpair Apple Home first.phone-direct; protocol code-only Subscription creep over a large EU base. HAP is Apple-documented but the tado zone mapping is code-only; link HAP and spec the mapping.Caveat: No generic HAP-IP spec exists here yet; SRP pair-setup and ChaCha20 sessions are most of the work. Zone names still need cloud. M TadoLocal HomeKit backend · tado_ce HA integration · HA core #151223: tado API quotas Danfoss Eco (eco 2) Bluetooth radiator thermostatActive; sold since August 2017 with BLE firmware updates. Community tooling is stale: etrv2mqtt archived 2024-09-08. C · P4 BLE GATT only, no cloud. Write the PIN (default 0000), press the physical button, read the per-device key; values are XXTEA-encrypted.phone-direct; protocol code-only Best-selling European BLE TRV, phone-direct. The key handshake and XXTEA framing are recorded only in archived or unmaintained libraries. Complements the eQ-3 TRV spec.Caveat: Not Danfoss Ally (Zigbee). Model numbers unverified; behaviour may vary by firmware. Paraphrase XXTEA framing, do not copy code. M dsltip Danfoss-BLE original RE · python-danfoss-eco-2 (XXTEA, key) · libetrv Python library Gardena Bluetooth water controls, valves, pumps and sensorsVendor active. Water Control 01889-20 reportedly EOL, replaced in 2025 by Smart Water Control G-19033/19034/19050-20 (unverified). C · P4 BLE GATT direct to the device with Gardena-specific characteristics; 2025 models add an LWM2M-Execute style valve command. No gateway or cloud.phone-direct; protocol code-only Ubiquitous in European gardens; the characteristic map exists only as a Python table in one library. Adds phone-direct BLE irrigation beside the Wi-Fi-only Rachio spec.Caveat: Two protocol generations. Sources disagree on pairing limits (single versus up to 10 adapters); verify on hardware. Mowers out of scope. M elupus gardena-bluetooth characteristics · Home Assistant Gardena Bluetooth · maxritter Smart Water Control fork Qingping (ClearGrass) BLE sensors, stock 0xFDCD formatJuly listQingping active; not independently sourced (unverified) C · P4 Passive BLE advertisements with service data 0xFDCD; no connection, pairing or cloud. Home Assistant integration is Local Push.phone-direct; protocol code-only The stock Qingping frame is decoded in parser code but written down nowhere; the repo covers CGG1 only on pvvx firmware. Cheap, zero-hardware passive spec.Caveat: CGDK2 is not in the qingping-ble device table; exclude it unless a capture proves otherwise. ble_monitor docs are out of date. xiaomi-lywsd03mmc.yaml covers CGG1/CGDK2 only on pvvx custom firmware; this entry is the stock format. S qingping-ble 0xFDCD parser · Home Assistant Qingping integration Salus iT600 gateways (UG600 / UGE600 / UG800)Vendor active; pyit600 unmaintained. A July 2025 UG800 firmware update broke it (reported 2025-11-18); fork 0.6.1 released 2026-06-29. (community-sourced) C · P4 Gateway LAN HTTP with AES-encrypted JSON, key derived from the gateway EUID; three crypto generations (CBC-256, CBC-128, CCM). Enable 'Local WiFi Mode' first.phone-direct; protocol code-only EUID-keyed encrypted local API known only from client code (code-only), already abandoned once, and the vendor keeps changing the crypto; widely installed in UK/EU heating.Caveat: Paraphrase key derivation, never paste encryptor code; maintainer must approve publishing the fixed IV and key prefix. Scope: iT600 gateways only. M salus-it600-client maintained fork · pyit600 original client · pyit600 issue #48: UG800 break Melnor RainCloud Wi-Fi water timer (hub and RF valves)Cloud ended: after 2026-04-15 the app no longer connects to the timer; customers emailed from November 2025. No replacement offered. A · P3 No phone-direct path. Redirect the hub's cloud hostnames with local DNS and run a Pusher-compatible WebSocket and HTTP server (sunshower, melnor_decloudify). Unencrypted.needs a host/bridge; protocol community-documented Orphaned five months ago after big-box distribution. The cloud-replacement path is scattered across hobby repos from about 2018-2020; a spec would describe the server to emulate.Caveat: Spec describes a replacement server behind DNS redirection, not a phone app. Hub-to-valve RF link is undocumented. Placeholder RF serials and hash keys. M sunshower protocol.md · melnor_decloudify README · Hackaday RainCloud de-cloudifier Balboa BWA Wi-Fi spa module (50350 / BW503)Parts dealer reports cloud access for older BWA modules becoming a paid subscription of about €25/yr in Europe; local mode stays free. B · P3 TCP 4257 on the LAN, discovery by UDP broadcast to port 30303; same framing on the RS-485 bus. Vendor app does initial setup.phone-direct; protocol community-documented Subscription creep across many hot-tub brands. The community write-up lacks connection lifecycle and multi-client behaviour, so a normalised spec still adds value.Caveat: Close to link, don't spec. Model naming differs (BW503 vs 50350). Document the pack's setpoint limits; never suggest bypassing them. S ccutrer balboa protocol.md · Home Assistant Balboa integration Big Ass Fans Haiku, i6 and es6 (SenseME and i6 protobuf)Vendor healthy. April 2022 firmware 3.x broke legacy SenseME; aiosenseme archived 2023-06-09 over the protocol change (community-sourced). C · P3 Firmware 3.x fans: LAN protobuf protocol with local push and no account (aiobafi6). Legacy SenseME fans need UDP port 31415.phone-direct; protocol code-only Two undocumented protocol generations; the newer protobuf schema lives only in one hobbyist .proto file in aiobafi6. The repo has no fan coverage.Caveat: Risk is vendor protocol churn, not vendor failure. Confirm i6 transport from aiobafi6 code; TCP 31415 for both generations is unconfirmed. M aiobafi6 i6 protobuf library · Home Assistant Big Ass Fans · aiosenseme legacy SenseME library Drayton Wiser HeatHub (Schneider Wiser)Active; as of 2026-09 Drayton still sells 2nd-generation HubR kits with no end-of-life notice; Schneider sells it in the EU. C · P3 Press Setup, join the hub's setup access point and fetch the secret once; then local HTTP JSON REST controls rooms, iTRVs, hot water, schedules.phone-direct; protocol code-only Leading UK/EU multi-zone heating hub with an undocumented local REST API (code-only) and phone-doable secret onboarding; the repo has no hub-style heating system.Caveat: Auth header name and 'HubT' model are unverified; check library code. Cover V1/V2 hub differences and frost-protection and boiler-interlock behaviour. M wiserHeatAPIv2 local API notes · wiserHeatAPIv2 library · python-draytonwiser-api secret retrieval Ecosense RadonEye RD200 (v1 and v2)Active; Ecosense still sells the RD200 at $169 with Bluetooth app monitoring and on-device storage (checked 2026-09). C · P3 Phone connects directly over BLE GATT; v1 answers a 0x50 command write, v2 uses 0x50/0x40/0x51 for averages, peak and device info. No cloud.phone-direct; protocol code-only Popular Airthings alternative the phone talks to directly; two incompatible generations are split across hobby repos (code-only). Extends the air-quality sensor cluster.Caveat: Two incompatible generations; the spec must say how to tell them apart, e.g. by the serial prefixes jdeath/rd200v2 lists. S jdeath/rd200v2 v1 and v2 · radonpy v1 library · HA community RadonEye BLE thread Intex PureSpa Wi-Fi spas (e.g. SC-WF20 module)Active consumer product. No shutdown or subscription claim was checked (unverified). C · P3 Direct TCP over the home LAN to the spa's built-in Wi-Fi module, with no Intex cloud. A phone on the same LAN needs no extra hardware.phone-direct; protocol code-only A mass-market spa with a real local LAN protocol that is written down only in client code. A small spec for a large installed base.Caveat: The port and frame format are only in client code. Keep setpoints within the vendor's limits (20-40 C) and never describe how to bypass them. S aio-intex-spa local TCP client · homey-intex-spa local app Lennox iComfort S30 / S40 / E30 thermostatsActive; S40 local access needs firmware 04.25.0070 or later, M30 is cloud-only, and firmware updates may break local access. (unverified) C · P3 HTTPS message API on the thermostat's LAN address: connect with a client-chosen app ID, publish commands, retrieve messages. S30, S40, E30; not M30.phone-direct; protocol code-only Major US ducted-HVAC brand whose capable local API exists only in lennoxs30api (code-only), filling the gap between Radio Thermostat and Venstar/ecobee coverage.Caveat: HVAC control: document safe setpoint and mode ranges, not installer parameters; port 443 and the self-signed certificate are unverified. M lennoxs30api library · lennoxs30 HA integration Melnor, Eden and EcoAquastar Bluetooth hose timersMelnor's 2026-04-15 RainCloud shutdown covers only the Wi-Fi timer; that the Bluetooth line is unaffected is inferred (unverified). C · P3 Direct BLE from phone or HA with no bridge, local polling. The valve ignores discovery while another device is connected.phone-direct; protocol code-only Cheap, widely sold multi-brand BLE hose timer, phone-direct, with the protocol recorded only in one library. Natural sibling of the RainCloud entry.Caveat: Single central only: a connected phone blocks others. HA docs list Melnor and Eden; EcoAquastar support rests on the library alone. S melnor-bluetooth reverse-engineered library · Home Assistant Melnor Bluetooth Orbit B-hyve Bluetooth hose timers (HT25, HT32A, HT34, XD)Vendor active; XD 2-outlet Bluetooth timer (24632) listed but sold out on 2026-09-23. BLE needs a per-mesh key from the cloud. C · P3 Phone controls the timer directly over BLE GATT. The cloud is needed once to fetch the per-mesh AES network key, then BLE only.phone-direct; protocol code-only Likely the highest-volume consumer hose timer. Cipher and framing, recently reverse-engineered, live in one 12-star repo with per-hardware-family differences.Caveat: The network key is a per-user secret: placeholders only. Document how owners can keep the key without the cloud. M orbit-bhyve-ble local BLE integration Rain Bird LNK / LNK2 Wi-Fi module (ESP-TM2, ESP-Me)Active; LNK2 product page current (documents dated Dec 2023), listing ESP-ME, ESP-ME3, ESP-TM2, ESP-RZXe and LXME2 compatibility. C · P3 LAN JSON-RPC 'tunnelSip' carrying SIP command frames, payload encrypted with the device password. LNK1 over HTTP, LNK2 over HTTPS.phone-direct; protocol code-only One of the two biggest residential irrigation brands; phone reaches the module on the LAN. SIP commands and encryption exist only in client code. Fills gap beside Rachio.Caveat: LNK2 may return 503 under concurrent polling; pace ~100 ms. Some ESP-TM2 firmware reportedly answers locally only with internet blocked. M pyrainbird HA core library · homebridge-rainbird-local SIP-over-JSONRPC Nest Learning Thermostat Gen 1 / Gen 2research target · July listGoogle ended cloud features for Gen 1 and Gen 2 on 2025-10-25; manual control still works. A · P3 Not phone-direct: one-time USB DFU flash from Linux or macOS points the thermostat at a replacement server, hosted or self-hosted (NoLongerEvil).needs a host/bridge; protocol code-only Largest abandoned-thermostat base; the device-to-server protocol now exists only as code in the NLE server. A server-side spec serves self-hosters and HA.Caveat: Describe the server wire protocol only, not the DFU exploit or firmware. Carry NLE's experimental, not-heating-critical warning. M NoLongerEvil-SelfHosted server · NLE self-hosted installation guide Eve HomeKit-over-BLE accessories and history protocolresearch targetVendor active. Eve's Matter upgrade switches off Bluetooth for smart-home use and cannot be undone (Notebookcheck, updated 2026-02-18). C · P3 HAP over BLE GATT: SRP pair-setup with the setup code, then an encrypted session, plus the Eve history service (E863F007). No hub or cloud.phone-direct; protocol community-documented Eve's history log format lives only in a Homebridge wiki marked tentative. BLE is disappearing as units move to Matter; could seed a HAP transport spec.Caveat: Link Apple's HAP spec rather than re-spec it. Fakegato formats come from emulation; verify on hardware. Check aiohomekit before calling it code-only. L fakegato Eve history protocol · fakegato Eve services and characteristics LeakSmart Zigbee shut-off valve and leak sensorsDiscontinued; Waxman shut down the LeakSmart cloud, app and hub (reported 2024-05-23; exact date unverified). Zigbee valves and sensors still work. A · P2 Reset and re-pair the valve to any Zigbee coordinator; open/close via the On/Off cluster. Battery end device, not a router. Wi-Fi sensors unrecoverable.needs a host/bridge; protocol community-documented Orphaned safety device (whole-home water shut-off); a re-pair and cluster-map rescue like the devolo Z-Wave spec. Needs a coordinator, so not phone-direct.Caveat: Warn that re-pairing loses the old hub's leak-to-close automation; leak-sensor cluster details are unverified and need a Z2M/ZHA quirk check. S Hubitat LeakSmart valve thread · SmartThings LeakSmart shutdown thread · Aartech LeakSmart closure report Carrier Infinity Touch / Bryant Evolution Connex thermostatsresearch targetActive; no Carrier status page was checked, so this is unverified. Firmware auto-updates can close the Infinitude proxy path (community-sourced). C · P2 Two paths, neither phone-direct. Either point the thermostat's HTTP proxy at Infinitude (compatible firmware only), or put an ESP32 SAM emulator on the ABCD RS485 bus.needs a host/bridge; protocol community-documented A large US HVAC base with no local vendor API. A decade of reverse engineering is spread across Perl code and an incomplete wiki, so one consolidated spec adds value.Caveat: Writes on the ABCD bus can mis-command HVAC equipment, so mark them caution-level. Describe the cloud XML fields; do not copy captured payloads. L Infinitude wiki protocol pages · Infinitude local proxy/REST · infinitESP RS485 SAM emulator

docs.title: Locks, garage doors, alarms and cameras
docs.text: Device and vendor status Risk Local path Why a spec, and the catch Effort Public work Paradox MG/SP/EVO alarm panels (IP150/IP100 or serial)Active vendor narrowing local paths: EVO 7.50.000+ adds irreversible serial encryption; direct IP150 access only below 4.0 or from 4.40.004 (community-sourced). B · P4 Phone TCP client to IP150/IP100 software port (usually 10000) with the module and PC passwords: arm/disarm plus zone and partition events. Serial is wired.phone-direct; protocol code-only Common installer-grade panel family that the vendor keeps pushing cloud-ward through firmware; the working local protocol exists only in PAI's code.Caveat: Never document a way around EVO 7.50+ serial encryption (possible DMCA 1201 circumvention). MG/SP and EVO need separate sections. L PAI Paradox Alarm Interface · ParadoxIP150v2 bridge (archived) PPPP P2P cameras (CS2 / iLnkP2P; X5/A9 mini cams)Anonymous ODMs, short-lived apps. CS2 P2P in 50M+ devices; CVE-2019-11219/11220, CVE-2020-9525/9526; 8.7M vulnerable online as of Oct 2022. B · P4 UDP LAN session: broadcast discovery on 32108, handshake, keepalives, then StreamStart; JPEG video and 8 kHz A-law audio. cam-reverse reports it works with outbound traffic blocked.phone-direct; protocol community-documented One family spec covers a long tail of sub-$5 cameras whose only control path is an OEM app that can vanish; the details remain scattered.Caveat: Scope to owner-side LAN use of CS2/iLnk variants; no UID enumeration or relay attacks. Some devices need the server for authentication. L Palant: overview of PPPP protocol · cam-reverse PPPP LAN client · hacked.camera vulnerability research Wyze Lock Bolt (YD_BT1)Still sold on wyze.com as of 2026-09-23, no discontinuation notice; local use depends on secrets fetched once from the Wyze cloud. B · P4 BLE GATT, Nordic-UART-style service with CRC-16/IBM framing; AES-128-ECB state and battery, challenge-response lock/unlock. Needs a one-time pull of three account-bound secrets.phone-direct; protocol code-only Mass-market lock with no local API, cloud-dependent keys and reverse engineering only in small 2025-2026 repos: the protocol-scattered-in-code case this repo targets.Caveat: Describe key retrieval only as account-bound secrets fetched once; do not copy the extraction script or cloud endpoints. M Wyze-Lock-Bolt-Local HA integration · Wyze-Bolt-WiFi-Bridge-ESP32 eQ-3 eqiva Bluetooth Smart Lock (KeyBLE)No dated discontinuation or support notice found; keyble warns a future firmware update could render it useless (unverified). C · P4 Local BLE GATT, no cloud: register with the Key Card QR and a held Unlock button, then AES-128 authenticated lock, unlock, open and status.phone-direct; protocol code-only Widely sold EU retrofit lock whose protocol is known only from keyble code, which depends on a largely abandoned BLE library and risks bit-rot.Caveat: Document owner registration with the physical Key Card only, no bypass; placeholder Key Card data, user keys and lock MACs. M keyble Node.js CLI/API · home-assistant-eqiva-keyble integration Xiongmai / XMEye DVRIP (NETIP, Sofia) cameras, DVRs, NVRsActive white-label OEM, no known shutdown (unverified). C · P4 LAN TCP 34567 DVRIP: binary header plus JSON for login, config, snapshots, media, PTZ. UDP 34569/34571 for config and discovery.phone-direct; protocol code-only Huge rebrand base after Hikvision and Dahua; protocol exists only as code, a dissector and scattered notes. One family spec, like tuya and PPPP.Caveat: Cover only authenticated control and media; exclude exploit, backdoor, telnet and password-recovery material. Warn on firmware upgrade. Cite vendor PDFs, never copy. L DVRIP_analysis Wireshark dissector · OpenIPC python-dvr library · dvrip Python library Level Lock (Level Bolt, Level Lock, Level Lock+)research target · note: research-notes/level-lock.mdAssa Abloy laid off most Level Home staff on 2026-06-26, folding Level into Kwikset; cloud still up, support promised. B · P4 HomeKit (BLE or Thread) and Matter over Thread lock and unlock locally. The vendor's own BLE GATT protocol is not reverse-engineered.phone-direct; protocol undocumented Gutted vendor sliding towards orphaned. Research note already holds candidate UUIDs; an HCI-snoop session could yield a greenfield BLE spec for guest keys, door status and settings.Caveat: Treat research-note UUIDs as hypotheses until a capture confirms them. Document owner operation only, no bypasses; no app-internal class names. L AppleInsider on Level layoffs Arlo Pro 2 cameras (VMB4000r3 base-station emulation)Arlo is active. End-of-life dates for Arlo Pro 2 and VMB4000-era base stations not found (unverified). B · P3 arlo-cam-api emulates a VMB4000r3 as a hostapd access point, driving cameras over a proprietary socket with REST, webhooks and RTSP. Needs a Linux AP host.needs a host/bridge; protocol code-only Large battery-camera base whose base-station protocol lives only in emulator code. Fails phone-direct, so it suits the Home Assistant side rather than the app.Caveat: Emulator commits date from Dec 2020 to Jan 2021, not recent. Source any EOL claim. No firmware, certificates or keys in the spec. M arlo-cam-api base-station emulator · arlo-base-station on rooted Orbi Nice IT4WIFI (NHK) gate/garage Wi-Fi interfaceNice S.p.A. appears to be a going concern with an optional cloud relay; no shutdown or subscription evidence found (unverified). C · P3 MyNice pairs using the cover setup code for a long-lived credential; then LAN control via mDNS _nhk._tcp. Sources conflict: port 8080 versus TLS 443.phone-direct; protocol community-documented Major gate-automation brand whose phone-direct LAN protocol is spread across small, conflicting fork-level repos dating back to 2020; a spec would consolidate it.Caveat: Never use vendor names from mynicelib's decompiled-notes folder; first check whether Nice publishes an official integrator protocol. M mynicelib protocol docs · nice-it4wifi-ha PROTOCOL.md · homeassistant_nicegate integration Qolsys IQ Panel 2/2+/4 local interfacesHealthy: now IQ Security Products under Johnson Controls (2026 footer); the consumer app normally uses the Alarm.com dealer cloud. C · P3 LAN socket via Control4 integration setting, enabled with the dealer code: token, state, events, arm/disarm, 4-minute keep-alive. Alternative: IQ Remote emulation over local MQTT.phone-direct; protocol code-only Dominant dealer-installed touchscreen panel in North America; its only local paths are a semi-hidden integration socket and MQTT emulation, known only from community code.Caveat: Port 12345 and TLS are unconfirmed; check in code. Enabling needs a dealer or installer code some owners lack. M qolsysgw Control4 gateway · QolsysController IQ Remote emulation Risco Agility / WiComm / LightSYS / ProSYS Plus panelsRisco Cloud and the iRisco app are the default path; older models may need cloud disconnection for local use (unverified). C · P3 Phone TCP client to the panel's IP module on port 1000 with access code and panel ID: arm/disarm, zones, bypass, outputs, events.phone-direct; protocol code-only Widely installed pro-grade panel family whose local protocol exists only in library code, avoiding the cloud path the vendor app defaults to.Caveat: Mono-socket IP modules may refuse local connections while RiscoCloud is enabled; cover the proxy pattern. Requires the owner's access code. M pyrisco Python library · risco-lan-bridge compatibility table · Home Assistant Risco docs TP-Link Tapo cameras (local HTTPS control API)TP-Link is active; no status page found. Firmware updates can break authentication, and Third-Party Compatibility must be enabled in the app (unverified). C · P3 Local HTTPS JSON API for PTZ, privacy, detection, alarms and settings, authenticated with a camera account; RTSP/ONVIF video and encrypted recording download.phone-direct; protocol code-only A best-selling budget camera line. The repo's ONVIF spec covers streaming only; the control API, with its changing auth, lives only in pytapo.Caveat: Version the spec by firmware because auth varies. Never publish default root credentials from hardware RE; advise a segmented network. M pytapo local camera library · HomeAssistant-Tapo-Control integration Gigaset elements alarm system (base, sensors, siren)research targetGigaset AG insolvent 2023-09-19; Smart Home/Care business and its servers shut down 2024-03-29. A · P3 No phone-direct path. DNS-redirect the base's cloud host to a self-hosted emulator; the base accepts a self-signed certificate.needs a host/bridge; protocol code-only Bricked German alarm platform whose base-to-cloud protocol lives in one 2026 emulator. The concrete local DNS-redirect case flagged as future work.Caveat: Single-author, thin source; fails the phone-direct filter. Exclude the camera repo's firmware patching and password recovery. Cross-reference research-notes/y-cam.md. L gigaset_elements_emulator Tapplock one (BLE fingerprint padlock)research targetSite still lists one+ and lite, footer shows 2021, original one absent. App and cloud status unverified. B · P3 Phone talks to the lock directly over BLE. Public RE covers only the 2018 firmware; later firmware scheme is unknown. Fingerprint unlock works offline.phone-direct; protocol community-documented Well-known BLE padlock from a small startup, known only from a 2018 security post and a tiny repo. Would complement the SafeTech and TTLock padlock specs.Caveat: The 2018 credential scheme is an unlock recipe: frame as owner operation and firmware detection. Current firmware needs a capture. Paraphrase blog names. M Pen Test Partners Tapplock write-up · darkfader/tapplock scripts Eufy Security P2P (HomeBase, cameras, doorbells, locks)research targetAnker/eufy active. Main community client archived 2026-09-12 (last release 4.0.0, 2026-05-28); development moved to a successor repo (community-sourced). C · P3 Proprietary UDP P2P to HomeBase, camera or lock, direct on the same LAN: livestream, arm/disarm, lock commands, events. Keys come from a cloud login.phone-direct; protocol code-only A large no-subscription camera, doorbell and lock estate whose P2P protocol exists only as client code, and the main library was just archived.Caveat: Cloud key bootstrap limits local survival; state what works without the cloud. Owner-side use only; nothing that reaches others' devices via relay. L eufy-security-client (archived) · HomeBase 3 cmd 2037 fix Nello One (Wi-Fi intercom door opener)Original vendor gone; status page inactive as of 2026-09-23. Sclak acquisition and insolvency dates unverified (community-sourced). A · P2 Plain MQTT on port 1883 with AES-CBC payloads; local DNS redirect sends the device to a local broker. Needs DNS control and the per-device key.needs a host/bridge; protocol community-documented Orphaned intercom opener common in EU apartment buildings, with a documented cloud-replacement path. Not phone-direct (DNS plus broker), so below the BLE and LAN items.Caveat: Cover owner takeover and topic semantics, not the unlock-bypass replay. Key may need a flash dump. Source Sclak and insolvency dates first. M open-nello protocol docs · LFE89 local takeover Danalock V3 (BLE retrofit lock)research targetCorporate status unknown: vendor site unreadable, no bankruptcy or acquisition source found (unverified). B · P2 Phone app talks BLE directly, but that protocol has no public RE; integrations use the vendor cloud and DanaBridge. Z-Wave and Zigbee variants are local.phone-direct; protocol undocumented Popular Nordic retrofit lock whose only third-party route is the vendor cloud. A BLE capture would be new work, likely including a crypto handshake.Caveat: Risk class is unsourced; if Danalock is healthy it drops to low priority. Z-Wave and Zigbee variants need links, not a spec. L ha-danalock-cloud (no direct BLE) Master Lock Bluetooth padlocks (4400EC, 4401LHEC)research targetActive line sold through the Master Lock Vault app; vendor says locks open offline with encrypted digital keys. C · P1 Phone opens the lock over BLE, offline once the app holds the key. Keys come from the vendor cloud; no public work avoids that.phone-direct; protocol undocumented Mass-retail BLE padlock dependent on cloud-issued keys. Worth only a feasibility pass by HCI snoop on the owner's lock; low priority.Caveat: The only prior-art repo is a cloud API client, not BLE. Possible DMCA 1201 exposure: never publish key-extraction methods. L master_lock_api cloud client

docs.title: Audio, video, TV and displays
docs.text: Device and vendor status Risk Local path Why a spec, and the catch Effort Public work LG Wi-Fi soundbars and speakers (SK/SN series)LG is active; the only community reference, google/python-temescal, was archived read-only on 2024-05-28. C · P4 TCP 9741: 0x10-framed JSON, AES-CBC under a fixed key and IV shared by every unit; mute, volume, input and sound mode.phone-direct; protocol code-only A common soundbar family whose protocol exists only in one archived library; phone-direct and code-only, so worth recording before it rots.Caveat: Describe the fixed key and cite the library; do not reproduce key bytes. Night mode, DRC and S-series support unverified. S python-temescal (archived) · Home Assistant LG Soundbar GoPro legacy Wi-Fi control (HERO3/3+ and HERO4)Vendor status for these models unconfirmed; community reference goprowifihack archived 2025-03-02. (unverified) A · P3 Phone joins the camera's own access point and sends HTTP GETs: HERO3/3+ use a password-parameter CGI scheme, HERO4 uses gpControl. Wake-on-LAN powers on a HERO4.phone-direct; protocol community-documented Open GoPro covers only newer models; the older API is documented only in an archived community repo. Phone-direct by design.Caveat: Two command sets: HERO3/3+ do not use gpControl. Media-list and preview-stream ports unconfirmed; source vendor status before publishing. M goprowifihack HERO4 Wi-Fi commands · goprowifihack HERO3 Wi-Fi commands LG NetCast smart TVs (NetCast 3.0/4.0, 2012-2013)Superseded by webOS; Home Assistant supports NetCast 3.0 (2012) and 4.0 (2013). Whether LG's current app supports NetCast is unverified. B · P3 LAN HTTP/XML remote API: the TV shows a pairing key, then the client sends key codes and queries. No network power-on.phone-direct; protocol code-only The lg-webos spec covers 2014 onward only; this older, orphaned protocol lives only in one small Python library (code-only).Caveat: Check first whether LG circulated a UDAP/ROAP developer document; if so, link rather than spec. Endpoints and port unverified. S python-lgnetcast library · Home Assistant LG NetCast Sonos speakers (S1 and S2), UPnP/SOAP on port 1400Active vendor; S1 frozen as legacy since 2020, May 2024 app redesign drew a July 2024 CEO apology; owners can now disable UPnP. B · P3 UPnP/SOAP on TCP 1400, SSDP discovery, GENA events: playback, grouping, volume and queue with no cloud. Requires the owner's UPnP setting on.phone-direct; protocol community-documented Probably the largest multi-room base with no spec here; S1-only hardware is a stranded fleet. The UPnP surface is documented only unofficially.Caveat: Keep it focused and link svrooij for the full action list; leave out the S2 WebSocket API and music-service auth until sourced. M svrooij unofficial Sonos API docs · Generated Sonos service docs · Home Assistant Sonos integration AirPlay and RAOP receivers (family discovery spec)Apple discontinued AirPort in April 2018; AirPlay 2 reached the 2012 AirPort Express on 2018-08-28. Protocol owner healthy. C · P3 Fully local: mDNS AirPlay and RAOP TXT records (features, srcvers, model, deviceid), HTTP /info, RTSP/RTP audio. AirPlay 2 adds HAP-style pairing.phone-direct; protocol community-documented Several specs cite AirPlay TXT fields ad hoc. A family discovery spec, like chromecast-castv2, gives autodetection one place to identify receivers, including the abandoned AirPort Express.Caveat: Scope to discovery and identification. Exclude FairPlay authentication and DRM entirely because of DMCA 1201 exposure. B · P4 Reset into the cooker's setup AP, provision Wi-Fi, derive the local key on-phone without cloud, then control via Midea LAN (TCP 6444).phone-direct; protocol code-only Reuses midea-ac-lan's transport; only the 0xEC payload and provisioning are new, and on-phone key derivation drops the one-time cloud token step.Caveat: Remotely energises a heater and pressure vessel: carry an attended-use-only warning and keep to status and presets. S gkfabs/InstantPot local control BSH Home Connect appliances (Bosch / Siemens)BSH and Home Connect are active (finances unsourced); per hcpy2-0, cloud login recently added a CAPTCHA, making key harvesting a manual step. C · P4 Appliance LAN WebSocket: TLS-PSK on 443 (dishwashers) or AES-CBC plus HMAC frames (washers, coffee machines); keys from one-time cloud login.phone-direct; protocol code-only Probably the largest kitchen and laundry local-protocol base; the vendor app itself uses this LAN path, yet details live only in hcpy code and one blog post.Caveat: Local use hinges on a one-time cloud key harvest BSH could change. Never commit real PSK/IV values, serials or feature XML. L Trammell Hudson Home Connect write-up · osresearch hcpy local client · hcpy2-0 maintained continuation De'Longhi ECAM bean-to-cup machines (Coffee Link BLE)De'Longhi is active; the claim that a newer app is replacing Coffee Link has no source (unverified). C · P4 Phone to machine over BLE GATT: 0x0D-framed requests with CRC-16, 0xD0 responses; brewing, power, settings and alarms. One connection at a time.phone-direct; protocol code-only Huge European base; the protocol exists only in source form across five disagreeing repos, one a rewrite fixing byte parsing. Phone-direct, no hardware changes.Caveat: Keep the Wi-Fi LAN path out of the first BLE spec; paraphrase recipe IDs, never copy per-model JSON tables. M longshot ECAM BLE client · cafy packet format and checksum · Kannix2005 protocol rewrite Pit Boss (Dansons) Wi-Fi/Bluetooth pellet grills and smokersActive; the vendor still runs its WebSocket relay. No shutdown or subscription gating found. (unverified) C · P4 Phone-direct BLE with no account. Mongoose OS controllers also offer local HTTP RPC; ESP-IDF controllers have no local HTTP.phone-direct; protocol code-only A mass-market grill line with phone-direct BLE, documented only in one Python library. Fills the grill gap, as Traeger is parked as cloud-bound.Caveat: Remote ignition is a fire risk; warn clearly. Do not copy vendor-supplied per-model command definitions; paraphrase frame semantics. M pytboss library · ha-pitboss integration Anova Precision Cooker Nano and Mini (BLE)July listApp subscription-gated for new accounts since 2024-08-21, with existing users grandfathered. Vendor developer docs cover the Nano, Mini, Wi-Fi cookers and Oven. A · P3 Phone-direct BLE. The Nano sends COBS-framed protobuf over TX/RX with an ASYNC status channel. The Mini uses JSON+Base64 on per-function characteristics. Wi-Fi models are cloud-only.phone-direct; protocol vendor-documented The same subscription trap as the original cooker, with a BLE path that needs no account. COBS framing plus an ASYNC channel would be a new pattern here.Caveat: Nano and Mini use two different protocols (device-candidates.md is wrong), so write separate profiles. Check the licence before transcribing the protobuf schema. M Anova Nano developer overview · Anova Mini developer overview Anova Precision Cooker, original (800W BT / 900W BT+Wi-Fi)July listApp needs a subscription for new accounts since 2024-08-21. The planned 2025 end-of-support was cancelled on 2025-01-16. A used unit on a new account stays paywalled. A · P3 Phone-direct BLE: ASCII commands ending in \r are written to FFE1 under service FFE0, and replies arrive as notifications. No account or cloud.phone-direct; protocol vendor-documented The subscription trap for used units makes this risk class A. The spec is small and quick, and a machine-readable YAML outlives a vendor-hosted page.Caveat: One characteristic serves both directions. Reassemble split notifications until \r. Cite facts from the developer site; do not copy its text. S Anova A2/A3 developer overview · SousVide communication protocol wiki Weber iGrill thermometers (mini, 2, 3, Pulse 2000)July listApp still maintained (updated 2025), but the original iGrill Classic has been dropped. The sister June oven cloud was retired on 2026-09-22. No mini/2/3 end-of-life has been announced. B · P3 The phone connects over BLE and completes a challenge-response handshake. It then reads or subscribes to probe temperatures and battery. No account or cloud.phone-direct; protocol community-documented Phone-direct BLE described only in community client code. Risk is rising: Weber cut the iGrill Classic from the app and has closed June's cloud.Caveat: Confirm the handshake on hardware; do not rely only on the zero-challenge shortcut. Never publish a vendor key. The Classic may differ. M bendikwa igrill.py handshake · esp32_iGrill client Acaia / Felicita smart coffee scales (Bookoo: link only)July listActive vendors; Bookoo publishes official MIT-licensed BLE protocols. Acaia and Felicita status not sourced. C · P3 BLE GATT direct from phone to scale: identify/heartbeat handshake, then weight and timer notifications plus tare and timer commands.phone-direct; protocol code-only Acaia's protocol, in old and new generations, exists only in client code. Spec Acaia and Felicita, link Bookoo; feeds brew-by-weight espresso setups.Caveat: Lunar 2021 needs a firmware update, so cover both generations. Felicita Parallel and non-S Pearl unconfirmed. Link Bookoo, don't spec it. M AcaiaArduinoBLE library · pyacaia Python module · Bookoo official BLE protocols Fellow Stagg EKG+ (BLE) / EKG Pro (Wi-Fi)July listActive vendor; no shutdown or subscription change found (unverified) C · P3 EKG+: BLE GATT direct, service 0x1820, 0xEFDD frame delimiter, fixed init frame. EKG Pro: local HTTP wrapper around an internal CLI on the LAN.phone-direct; protocol code-only Two generations with two transports, both only in hobby code; the EKG+ handshake is a clean teaching example for the BLE patterns page.Caveat: Remote heating risks dry-boil and scalds: rely on the kettle's own protection, discourage unattended use. EKG Pro authentication unverified on hardware. M EKG+ README with UUIDs, handshake · stagg-ekg-plus Python library · staggassistant EKG Pro integration MEATER / MEATER+ wireless meat probeJuly listActive vendor (Apption Labs); the official Home Assistant integration is cloud polling only (unverified) C · P3 BLE GATT from the phone to the probe or MEATER+ repeater; manufacturer ID 0x037B; accumulator/count temperature encoding; one connection at a time.phone-direct; protocol code-only The best-known wireless meat probe, with a partial RE and open unknowns spread across hobby repos. Cheap to verify; completes the repo's BLE thermometer family.Caveat: Scope to original MEATER and MEATER+; Pro and 2 Plus are unverified. The app must release the probe so the vendor app can connect. S meaterble BLE RE notes · Local BLE Home Assistant integration Miele@home appliances (XKM3100W module and native Wi-Fi)Healthy vendor. Its official route is the Miele cloud third-party API. Whether the XKM3100W module is still sold is unverified. C · P3 Phone talks signed, encrypted HTTP to the appliance or XKM module. It uses a GroupID/GroupKey from local provisioning of a reset appliance or from an existing pairing.phone-direct; protocol community-documented The local protocol exists only in community client code. It is phone-direct with implementable crypto. The official route is cloud-only, and appliances outlive vendor clouds.Caveat: Local pairing rules out the cloud integration. Placeholder all GroupID/GroupKey values. It is unconfirmed whether the XKM3100W and native Wi-Fi appliances share one scheme. L MieleRESTServer without cloud thread · ha-miele-at-lan · miele-xkm3100w PetKit Eversweet water fountains (W4/W4X, W5 family, CTW2, CTW3)Active; no distress source found. (unverified) C · P3 Phone-direct BLE GATT: filter life, pump runtime, battery, power, mode, light, DND. CTW3 needs the device's 8-byte secret.phone-direct; protocol code-only The pet category is thin in the repo. Several projects have re-derived the same BLE protocol, and the secret handshake is still open.Caveat: Record secret derivation as a known gap, not a guess. Setting the secret can disrupt the official app. Paraphrase command roles. M PetkitW5BLEMQTT bridge · ha-petkit local BLE · ha-petkit-ble integration Whisker Litter-Robot 4 (and LR3 Connect provisioning)No shutdown or subscription change sourced; Whisker appears to be an active going concern (unverified). C · P3 LR4: one-time BLE provisioning writes owner CA and broker, then MQTT/TLS on 8883 to a local broker. LR3 Connect: read-only UDP probe.needs a host/bridge; protocol code-only Best-known premium pet appliance with cloud-only app control. A working BLE re-provisioning trick makes it fully local, though runtime needs a broker.Caveat: Scope to LR4. Leave cat-detect and anti-pinch interlocks untouched; placeholder injected CA and device certificates; exclude LR5 exploit research. M whiskerless LR4 local MQTT · LR3 Connect UDP onboarding probe Furbo Dog Camera (Furbo 2 / 2.5T, 360, Mini)research target · July listActive vendor. Newer 'Subscription Required' models need a paid Furbo Nanny plan at setup; older standalone models keep a free tier. A · P3 TUTK/Kalay P2P with a same-subnet LAN mode, but credentials come from a cloud login; offline persistence unverified. Older Furbo 2 exposed RTSP on 554.phone-direct; protocol code-only Subscription gate plus a working LAN-mode TUTK path in community code, building on the Wyze spec's TUTK notes; Furbo commands (treat toss, pan) exist only in code.Caveat: Do not ship or reference the ThroughTek binary; paraphrase bridge command IDs. Subscription-Required units may do nothing until activated. L Furbo Bridge docs (TUTK, LAN mode) · Somerset Recon: Hacking the Furbo · go2rtc pure-Go TUTK package Petnet SmartFeeder (2nd gen / v2)research targetCloud went offline Feb 2020; staff furloughed and offices closed in late April 2020. The company is defunct. A · P3 V2 only: point DNS for the two Arrow Connect hostnames at a LAN host running FeederNet (HTTPS proxy plus MQTTS); the feeder runs unmodified.needs a host/bridge; protocol code-only Bricked device with a working community path whose HTTPS and MQTTS protocol exists only in FeederNet code: a clean-room Wi-Fi spec candidate, though not phone-direct.Caveat: Cover v2 only; Gen 1 needs hardware replacement. Describe topics in your own words, not FeederNet code. Provisioning and cert pinning unverified. M FeederNet petnet-feeder-service · esphome-petnet-feeder (Gen 1) JURA coffee machines (Smart Connect BLE dongle)Active vendor; no shutdown or subscription change found (unverified) C · P2 BLE GATT from the phone to the Smart Connect dongle on the machine's service port; the dongle advertises as 'TT214H BlueFrog'.phone-direct; protocol community-documented One community README covers the wire format; an implementation-independent spec would document the advertisement-derived key, the mandatory P-mode heartbeat and per-model XML.Caveat: Per-model machine XML files are vendor assets taken from the app: describe their role and structure, never commit them; owners supply their own. M Jutta-Proto BLE protocol README Mellow sous vide (V1 Wi-Fi, V2 Wi-Fi+BLE)research targetRecipes, scheduling and history moved behind a subscription in July 2020; manual control stays free. Server status in 2026 unverified. A · P2 Possibly V2 only, whose BLE reportedly allows direct phone control without the server; V1 is locked to vendor servers. No public BLE RE.phone-direct; protocol undocumented A plausible phone-direct BLE path on V2 that fits the app, but zero public RE, a small install base and no confirmation the servers are gone.Caveat: A spec needs first-hand V2 BLE captures; no Mellow-specific RE is publicly known, only Anova/Joule sous-vide work. L SlashGear on Mellow subscription · Gearbrain on Mellow subscription Sure Petcare Connect hub (cat flaps, pet doors, feeders, Felaqua)research targetActive as of 2026-09 and owned by Merck/MSD. Connect products are still sold in the UK and no shutdown notice was found. C · P2 Cloud impersonation: a DNS override plus a local MQTT/TLS broker on port 8883. The easy setup needs the Sure cloud up to fetch hub credentials.needs a host/bridge; protocol code-only Microchip flaps and feeders are common in the UK and EU. The message format exists only in PetHubLocal code. It is not phone-direct, so priority is lower.Caveat: Record the credential exchange before any cloud shutdown. Never commit certificates, credential files, firmware, PCAPs or step-by-step key extraction. L PetHubLocal setup guide · PetHubLocal local cloud replacement · PetHubLocal supported devices

docs.title: Printers, maker tools, robots, mowers and toys
docs.text: Device and vendor status Risk Local path Why a spec, and the catch Effort Public work Ryze / DJI Tello drone (app UDP protocol)Discontinued: DJI stopped sales in Asia in December 2023 and ended US educational products in January 2024. B · P4 Phone joins the drone's own Wi-Fi access point; binary UDP control framed with 0xCC and CRC8/CRC16; H.264 video arrives in separate UDP packets.phone-direct; protocol community-documented A widely owned, discontinued toy drone whose full app protocol lives only in a 2018 blog post and driver code; sits beside the parrot-arsdk-drone spec.Caveat: Flying device: include failsafe and land/emergency commands. Confirm UDP ports on hardware. Link the vendor text SDK rather than re-specifying it. M Gobot Tello packet write-up · TelloPy Python driver Anycubic Kobra LAN mode (HTTP 18910 + MQTT/TLS 9883)Active vendor; no shutdown or bankruptcy found, not independently sourced (unverified). C · P4 Enable stock LAN Mode: GET 18910/info, signed POST /ctrl, AES-decrypt broker credentials, then local MQTT over TLS on 9883. Kobra 2 unsigned.phone-direct; protocol code-only The Anycubic counterpart to the bambu-lab-lan spec; handshake crypto and topic layout exist only in 2026 Home Assistant code and a firmware update could re-key them.Caveat: Describe handshake structure only and link out for signing and AES keys; record firmware versions tested. Photon resin printers excluded. M anycubic_ha_local handshake flow · Kobra X / S1 LAN integration Creality K-series / Ender-3 V3 / Hi stock LAN WebSocketActive vendor: 4.4M printers shipped 2020-2024, product launches continuing into 2026; no shutdown found. C · P4 Stock firmware, no root: LAN WebSocket on TCP 9999 with JSON telemetry push and command/G-code passthrough, plus MJPEG camera.phone-direct; protocol code-only Huge installed base; the repo's Moonraker spec covers only rooted K-series, while the stock 9999 API lives only in Home Assistant integration code.Caveat: Record per-model field differences. Unverified whether any firmware adds authentication to 9999; K2, Ender and Hi coverage rests on one repo. M ha_creality_ws stock-firmware integration · hass_creality_k1 port 9999 FlashForge network protocol (TCP 8899 + HTTP 8898)Active vendor still shipping Adventurer 5M, AD5X and Creator 5; no shutdown found, not independently sourced (unverified). C · P4 Legacy: raw TCP 8899 '~M' text protocol. Adventurer 5M/AD5X/Creator 5: enable LAN mode, HTTP on 8898 authenticated by serial plus check code.phone-direct; protocol code-only Two protocol generations across a large budget-printer base, documented only by client code. One family spec with two transport sections fills the gap.Caveat: Placeholder any serial or check code captured during verification. Dremel/PowerSpec rebadge claim unverified; Adventurer 4 lacks the HTTP API. M ff-5mp-hass HTTP 8898 integration · flashforge-finder-api TCP 8899 · FlashForgeUI legacy and LAN client Dremel DigiLab 3D printers (3D20 / 3D40 / 3D45)Dremel says the brand is licensed to 3PI Tech Solutions and no longer supplied by Dremel; no date given. B · P3 LAN HTTP POST /command on port 80 (status, start, pause, cancel), uploads, camera on 10123, extra HTTPS status page on 11134.phone-direct; protocol code-only Original vendor has left a printer family common in schools and makerspaces; its LAN API lives only in one Python library.Caveat: Ports come from dremel3dpy constants; check on hardware. 3D20 is monitoring only. Keep any FlashForge channel separate. S dremel3dpy Python library · Home Assistant Dremel integration Fujifilm Instax Link BLE printersActive product line; Fujifilm still makes Instax cameras and printers. Link printer model dates are not listed. C · P3 Phone-direct BLE GATT, the same path the vendor apps use: status queries, chunked image transfer, then a print command. Mini Link 3 services differ.phone-direct; protocol code-only Very large consumer base; the protocol exists only as Python code built from a forum thread. Fills the photo-printer gap beside the thermal and label specs.Caveat: Specify the wire protocol, not app behaviour; call out per-model service differences. Instax Evo hybrid cameras belong in a separate spec. M InstaxBLE Python client · ESP32-Instax-Bridge printer emulator Husqvarna Automower (Automower Connect BLE)July listHusqvarna Group active; not independently sourced (unverified) C · P3 BLE GATT direct from phone to mower with no account or cloud; some Flymo units need a PIN entered by button presses.phone-direct; protocol code-only Europe's dominant robot mower and the repo's first; its protocol exists only as library code and a Wireshark dissector, with no written spec.Caveat: Upstream RE started from a decompiled app: write from library behaviour and own captures, no vendor identifiers. Only Automower 305 tested. M Automower BLE RE blog post · AutoMower-BLE library and dissector · Home Assistant Automower BLE integration xTool laser engravers (S1, D-series, REST V1, WS-V2)Active vendor, finances unsourced; per ha-xtool, a V2 firmware 'communication framework upgrade' broke LightBurn and XCS Mobile on some models. C · P3 LAN-direct, no account: UDP 20000 discovery, HTTP 8080 and WebSocket 8081 on older families; V2 firmware uses TLS WebSocket RPC on 28900.phone-direct; protocol community-documented Leading consumer laser brand documented in one Home Assistant repo; fills the repo's laser and maker-tool gap, and the V2 lockdown argues for capturing it now.Caveat: Class 4 lasers: status and job control only, no interlock bypass. Describe discovery encryption; never reproduce vendor key material. L ha-xtool PROTOCOL.md · ha-xtool Home Assistant integration Neato Botvac Connected / D3-D7research target · July list · note: research-notes/neato-botvac-d-series.mdNeato ceased operations May 2023; Vorwerk announced a cloud phase-out in late 2025 (statement around 2025-12-29), no fixed end date. A · P3 Stock HTTPS on TCP 4443 (legacy TLS, only /info confirmed) is unexplored. Full control today needs the UART port plus an ESP32 bridge, not phone-direct.needs a host/bridge; protocol community-documented A large, freshly orphaned fleet with a thorough research note already in the repo; probing the stock :4443 API decides whether a phone-direct spec exists.Caveat: Research target: probe :4443 on a D5 before writing a spec. Reconcile announcement dates. D8/D9/D10 are excluded by OpenNeato. L OpenNeato ESP32 replacement · Wikipedia: Neato Robotics Mammotion Luba / Yuka mowers and Spino pool robotsresearch targetVendor active; its ToS prohibits unofficial API access and PyMammotion warns of permanent account bans. (community-sourced) C · P3 Phone talks BLE GATT carrying protobuf messages when in range; no account needed for the transport. Wi-Fi and remote control go through vendor cloud MQTT.phone-direct; protocol code-only A large reverse-engineered protobuf BLE protocol lives in one library (code-only); a spec of the BLE framing plus a small command subset preserves the account-free local path.Caveat: Bladed autonomous vehicle: omit manual-drive commands, never document bypassing lift, tilt or obstacle interlocks; paraphrase semantics, don't transcribe the schema. L PyMammotion library · Mammotion-HA integration Nabaztag / Nabaztag:tag Wi-Fi rabbitMindscape bought Violet 2009-10-20, released server source 2011-07-27. Karotz servers stopped 2015-02-18. A · P2 Rabbit boots from a configurable HTTP server (v1 polling, v2 XMPP). ServerlessNabaztag firmware adds a local HTTP API, loaded via recovery mode.needs a host/bridge; protocol code-only A canonical orphaned device with an active hobby scene; the wire protocol is spread across half a dozen server codebases. Medium priority.Caveat: Cite, do not copy, the released server source. Separate v1 and v2 transports; drop Karotz. Link ServerlessNabaztag's OpenAPI. L ServerlessNabaztag firmware · NabAlive server · Mindscape-released server fork Phomemo thermal / label printers (M02, M110, T02, D30)Active vendor; no status source found (unverified). C · P2 Bluetooth Classic SPP/RFCOMM in most tools, BLE GATT via phomymo, plus USB; ESC/POS-derived raster, 48 bytes per line on M02.phone-direct; protocol community-documented A best-selling thermal printer brand whose protocol differs from the repo's cat-printer, NIIMBOT and Fichero specs; a family spec consolidates many per-model repos.Caveat: Document both SPP and BLE; iOS generally cannot use SPP, so BLE matters for the app. D-series and tape framing differ. The SPP models wait on a Bluetooth Classic schema value; spec the BLE models first. M phomemo-tools CUPS driver README · phomymo Web Bluetooth designer · phomemo_d30 label script Embodied Moxie companion robotresearch targetEmbodied shut down in 2024; successor Moxie Robots, Inc. is gradually re-pairing robots (v22.9.1501+) to its own cloud. A · P2 Firmware 24.10.801+ accepts a custom cloud endpoint; point the robot at a local OpenMoxie MQTTS broker on a PC or Pi. Not phone-direct.needs a host/bridge; protocol code-only An $800 robot orphaned by Embodied; the local route is a broker documented only in OpenMoxie code. Documentation-rescue tier, not an app target.Caveat: Child-directed device with camera and microphone: cover control and provisioning only, never capture pipelines. L OpenMoxie local MQTT hub · OpenMoxie architecture overview Jibo social robotresearch targetCloud shut down March 2019; assets went to NTT Disruption, which itself closed in 2023, so no vendor remains. A · P2 Only after a one-time PC/USB boot-ROM mod (RCM/ShofEL2): ROM WebSocket over the LAN on TCP 7160 (stock) or 8160 (community rom-control).phone-direct; protocol code-only A real LAN control channel with an active community revival, but the protocol lives only in community client code; worth a research note, not yet a spec.Caveat: Stock robots probably cannot be driven: the ROM certificate came via the dead Jibo cloud. Phone-direct applies after the mod, not setup. L Be-A-Maker patched app (ROM ports) · JiboExperiments OpenJibo and RE notes · jibo.guide RCM/ShofEL2 mod guide DJI Wi-Fi drones (Spark, Mavic Air, Mavic Mini / Mini SE)research targetIn December 2025 the FCC banned import and sale of new DJI drone models. Already-approved models were excluded, so existing drones keep working. B · P2 The phone joins the drone's own Wi-Fi access point. The command set is DUML, but how it maps onto the Wi-Fi app link is unconfirmed.phone-direct; protocol community-documented A large US installed base under regulatory risk. The path is phone-direct and sits next to the Parrot drone spec. Research goal: confirm what the Wi-Fi link carries.Caveat: Keep it read-only (telemetry, battery, media). Leave out flight control, geofencing and Remote ID. Cite dji-firmware-tools only for DUML framing, never keys. L dji-firmware-tools DUML dissectors Worx Landroid robot mowers (legacy WG796E/WG797E)research targetActive; Worx's own wiki documents current Landroid Vision setup. Positec's corporate health is unverified. C · P2 Legacy WG796E.1/WG797E only: LAN HTTP JSON at /jsondata.cgi on port 80, Basic auth with the mower PIN. Current models are cloud.phone-direct; protocol community-documented A small phone-direct LAN spec for legacy models documented only in community code and wikis; modest value, since they already work without the cloud.Caveat: Scope to legacy local-HTTP models. Unverified whether later firmware removed /jsondata.cgi, so confirm on real hardware first. S openHAB wiki Worx Landroid · worx-landroid-nodejs local API
