docs.text: Device and vendor status Risk Local path Why a spec, and the catch Effort Public work Boosted Boards (V1-V3, Mini, Plus, Stealth) and Revresearch target · note: research-notes/boosted-boards.mdLayoffs 2020-03-04; Lime bought assets and IP (confirmed 2020-04-16). Auth and firmware servers offline; app still connects locally. A · P5 BLE GATT direct from phone to board (V2/V3 service 7dc55a86…, V1 da2b84f1…); riding uses the handheld remote. Writes may need undocumented auth.phone-direct; protocol undocumented An orphaned board with a loyal installed base; no public BLE write-up exists, and the repo's research note already maps the characteristics.Caveat: Existing note cites a decompiled app and internal enum names: rewrite by role. Ride-mode writes stationary-only; leave firmware flashing out. M Forever Boosted FAQ · BoostedBreak CAN RE Lippert OneControl RV system (Unity X270D/X270L/X180T)Active; lippert.com (fetched 2026-09-23) describes app control over Bluetooth or Wi-Fi range, with no subscription terms stated. X180T tunnels IDS-CAN.phone-direct; protocol code-only Factory control system across North American towables and motorhomes; the whole coach runs through one BLE gateway whose protocol lives in a single young HA integration.Caveat: Fence off levelling, slide-out, awning and generator auto-start commands; do not publish vendor key constants or copy the diagnostic-code list. No shutdown or subscription found. C · P4 Phone joins the camera's own Wi-Fi access point; HTTP CGI (custom=1&cmd=NNNN&par=V) for files, settings and mode; RTSP for live view.phone-direct; protocol code-only One Novatek CGI command set spans a long tail of Viofo and white-label dashcams; the command map exists only inside sync tools and forum lore.Caveat: viofosync's command map came from vendor app assets: restate meanings, never copy the JSON. The TCP 3333 status socket is unconfirmed. M viofosync Novatek HTTP sync · dashcam-transporter Viofo offload Cowboy e-bikes (BLE)research targetNear-bankrupt after a May 2025 frame recall; acquisition by ReBirth Group Holding closed (The Verge, 2025-12-18); operates independently. B · P4 BLE GATT with 6-digit passkey pairing for lock/unlock, lights and assist; community apps and an nRF52 remote work without Cowboy's cloud.phone-direct; protocol code-only A connected-first e-bike that nearly failed and changed owner; its BLE protocol lives only inside two hobby apps with no written documentation.Caveat: Exclude motor-controller writes that remove the speed limiter (illegal under EU pedelec rules). Firmware drift risk. Research target, not spec-now. M nRF52 Cowboy BLE remote · Cowboy_Untamed Android app BlackVue dashcams (local Wi-Fi/LAN HTTP)Pittasoft/BlackVue active; BlackVue Cloud has a free tier and paid Smart Plans, but local offload needs no cloud. C · P3 The camera's built-in HTTP server on the LAN: file index at /blackvue_vod.cgi, downloads under /Record/. Direct access-point mode unconfirmed.phone-direct; protocol code-only The best-known premium dashcam brand; its local HTTP surface is documented only by one sync script and differs from the Novatek family.Caveat: Only listing and download are confirmed; settings control, HTTP authentication on newer firmware and the model list need a capture. S blackvuesync LAN sync tool Garmin Varia rear radar / radar-lightGarmin active; not independently sourced (unverified) C · P3 BLE GATT after bonding (long-press power at power-on); custom service 6a4e3200 streams threat notifications. No cloud; the ANT+ radar profile is generally unusable from phones.phone-direct; protocol code-only The dominant bike radar; a spec would let the phone act as a radar display without a Garmin head unit. The service is known only from small scripts.Caveat: Threat characteristic differs between Varia 820 and RTL515, so spec per model. Settings/light writes are research. Not a safety-certified display. M radarble Varia 820 BLE doc · variaconnector RTL515 threat receiver InMotion V-series and Ninebot Z electric unicyclesInMotion active; its website shows a current lineup and September 2026 posts. Ninebot Z sales status unverified. C · P3 BLE GATT serial notify stream plus command writes, phone to wheel directly with no cloud; the same path WheelLog uses.phone-direct; protocol code-only The euc-wheellog-ble spec covers only King Song, Gotway/Begode and Veteran; InMotion and Ninebot Z are decoded by WheelLog but have no spec.Caveat: Three wire formats: legacy InMotion, InMotion V2, XOR-keyed Ninebot Z. Mark power-off, speed-limit and tilt-back writes dangerous or omit them. M WheelLog InMotion V2 adapter · WheelLog Ninebot Z adapter · WheelLog Android README VanMoof S5 / A5 e-bikeresearch targetSame company as the S3/X3: Dutch bankruptcy 2023-07-17, Lavoie acquisition announced 2023-08-31; S5/A5 released 2022. A · P3 Phone-direct BLE; a beta Home Assistant integration exposes sensors and buttons. Whether a cloud-issued key is needed is unknown.phone-direct; protocol code-only A different BLE protocol generation from the S3/X3, so it needs its own spec; public reverse engineering is thin and code-only.Caveat: Research target: auth/key model is undocumented. Same vehicle-safety rule as S3/X3 — no speed-limit or region changes. L VanMoof S5/A5 Home Assistant integration · vanmoof-tools firmware tooling Votol EM-series motor controllers (EM50 to EM260)research target · July listActive; votol.cn still sells EM-series controllers, but phone tooling sits behind a WeChat mini-program with per-unit Bluetooth ID binding. B · P3 CAN query/response telemetry is community-decoded; serial config sniffed from the Windows configurator. The vendor Bluetooth dongle's protocol is undocumented.phone-direct; protocol community-documented Fills a gap beside fardriver-controller: CAN telemetry lives only in forum posts and code, and the phone-direct dongle path is unwritten.Caveat: Confirm the dongle is BLE, not HC-05 SPP, before promising phone-direct. VotolAIO may redistribute vendor binaries: cite decoded facts only. M bananu7/votol RE notes · Endless Sphere EM100 CAN protocols · VotolAIO serial protocol decoding

docs.title: Handle with care
docs.text:
A few rules cut across the tables. The verification pass raised each of them on more than one device.

  • Bluetooth Classic has a home in the schema since 2026-09-27. When this survey was written device.protocol was ble, wifi, lan, zigbee, zwave, obd2, uart or can, so an RFCOMM/SPP device had nowhere to go, and that blocked the Bose QuietComfort, Sony and Galaxy Buds control protocols, Apple's AAP, and the Parrot Zik, Jambox and Nuraphone research notes. bluetooth_classic landed as spec evolution P17 together with the bluetooth_classic block, bt_classic_inquiry discovery, rfcomm commands and a required corebluetooth host-compatibility verdict; the Quin pill box is the first spec written against it and the patterns are in Common Bluetooth Classic Patterns. The rows below are unblocked on the spec side. The mobile app still needs an RFCOMM transport, and iOS cannot open SPP at all — say so per spec in host_compatibility.
  • One-time key exports. VanMoof, Fossil Hybrid HR, Oura, GE Cync and EcoFlow need a per-device key or account identifier that only the vendor cloud ever issued. Tapo/KLAP needs the cloud account's credentials, which the device learned during a cloud-mediated setup. Spec the key's role, format and where the owner can retrieve their own key. Never commit a key, and say plainly what happens once the retrieval service is gone.
  • Things that move, heat or are worn by an infant. For e-bikes, boards, EV chargers, beds, pressure cookers, grills and baby monitors, keep the spec to what the vendor app itself did. Leave out speed-limit, region and charge-current overrides beyond the installer's rating, and any alarm-replacement behaviour. The VanMoof, Boosted, JuiceBox, Sleep Number, Instant Pot and Owlet rows each carry the specific caveat.
  • Firmware that has already locked the door. For Echelon, spec only the pre-July-2025 BLE profile, which is already public. The newer server challenge, and any way around it, is out of scope: a working jailbreak exists but cannot legally be released (404 Media).
  • Sources derived from decompiled apps. Several public projects say they were built by decompiling the vendor app. Examples: the EcoFlow BLE work, the Sleep Number MCR protocol, one Cozmo stack, and a Joule project that republished .proto files. Take wire-level facts only, restate them in your own words, and never copy schema files, constants or class names. See Clean-room Rules.

Held back entirely:

Device Why it is held back Public work Continuous glucose monitors (Libre, Dexcom G7, others)Abbott, Dexcom, Roche, i-SENS, Sibionics and Microtech all active; no shutdowns sourced (unverified). Large, motivated user base with protocols living only inside two big GPL apps, but those mature apps already serve users: link, don't spec.Caveat: Medical device driving insulin dosing: at most a pointer page with a not-for-treatment disclaimer; no handshake or key details. Juggluco direct sensor client · xDrip+ CGM app

Bluetooth Classic control protocols — unblocked since bluetooth_classic landed (see the first bullet above); each needs a bluetooth_classic block, rfcomm commands and an incompatible verdict for corebluetooth:

Device Risk Local path Why a spec, and the catch Public work Apple AirPods and Beats (Proximity Pairing adverts, AAP control)Apple is healthy; value is purely local-first, as these features are limited to Apple hosts (unverified). C Passive BLE decode of the Proximity Pairing advert for battery, case and in-ear state; active ANC and settings control over Classic L2CAP. One of the most-owned BLE devices. The advert decode fits the app's BLE scan path now; the control channel lives only in LibrePods code.Caveat: Split into two specs. Advert decode is Android-only in practice; check for advert encryption on newer firmware. L2CAP control needs unsupported Classic. The passive BLE advert half could be specced now on its own. furiousMAC Continuity message formats · LibrePods AACP over L2CAP Bose QuietComfort headphones and earbuds (BMAP over RFCOMM)Bose ended SoundTouch cloud support on 2026-05-06, a sunset precedent; newer headphone models gate plain SET behind cloud authentication. B Classic RFCOMM with BMAP framing. Unauthenticated reads plus SETGET and START cover ANC, modes, EQ, name, auto-off, buttons and battery. Huge installed base across two protocol generations. A spec would consolidate them and record the authentication split before Bose closes the unauthenticated operators.Caveat: Do not document the cloud ECDH handshake for SET. Paraphrase vendor-app vocabulary in bose-rfcomm. Android only. NC700 and QC45 unconfirmed. bose-rfcomm protocol reference · bosectl BMAP control Samsung Galaxy Buds family (RFCOMM control)Samsung is healthy; full features tied to the Galaxy Wearable app on Android (unverified). C Direct RFCOMM session from the phone: battery, ANC and ambient, EQ, touch settings, find-my-buds. Gadgetbridge pairs six models without the vendor app. Huge installed base; protocol notes cover only the oldest models, newer generations are code-only, so a spec would consolidate them. Android only.Caveat: Not the repo's first RFCOMM spec. iOS will not work. Omit or clearly mark firmware-flashing and hidden debug writes; flashing could brick buds. GalaxyBudsClient protocol notes · Gadgetbridge Galaxy Buds support Sony 1000X, LinkBuds, WF-C and WH-CH headphones (RFCOMM control)Sony is healthy. Desktop SonyHeadphonesClient archived 2025-07-19; companion app rename unverified (community-sourced). C Phone talks Classic RFCOMM directly, like the vendor app: ANC and ambient, EQ, DSEE, touch controls, battery. Gadgetbridge supports 18 models. Best-selling headphone line whose protocol exists only in Gadgetbridge and an archived client. Phone-direct, no key: a clean code-only-to-spec job and the repo's first headphone spec.Caveat: Android only; iOS is blocked because Sony's iOS path uses MFi. Leave out firmware-update commands. Gadgetbridge Sony headphones support · SonyHeadphonesClient (archived)

docs.title: Link, don't spec
docs.text:
Real local control, but the protocol is already written down, by the vendor or in a clean community document. A fresh spec would compete with it rather than rescue anything: the pywemo situation the README describes. The useful contribution is a pointer, a setup guide or a helpful_videos entry. Promote one of these only if the existing document is at risk: a dead vendor's domain, or a single fragile repository. The Neurio note in the graduation table is exactly that case.

Device Risk What already documents it Local path Link Apple TV and HomePod remote control (MRP, Companion Link, DMAP)Apple is healthy, no shutdown risk; legacy DMAP units long out of support (unverified). C Fills the Apple gap in the repo's TV row. pyatv already documents the protocols well, so a thin discovery entry pointing at pyatv suffices.Caveat: Link pyatv rather than re-spec it. HomePod coverage rests on pyatv, not Home Assistant. Keep away from FairPlay. LAN only: mDNS discovery, then PIN-paired MRP or Companion Link sessions for playback, navigation, app launch and power; DMAP on legacy units. pyatv protocol documentation · pyatv library Awair Element / Omni / 2nd Edition (and sunset v1, Glow)Active but shrinking; Glow, Glow-C and Awair v1 were sunset from 2022-11-30 with no app, cloud or re-onboarding. B A simple vendor-published endpoint, so link it; worth an 'enable the Local API now, before the cloud dies' note. Sunset v1/Glow have no known path.Caveat: Endpoint details come from search snippets and HA/python_awair docs because support pages returned 403. PitchBook details are unverified. Element, Omni and 2nd Edition: a vendor-documented LAN HTTP JSON GET endpoint. Element and 2nd Edition need the toggle set in the cloud app. Awair Element Local API · Awair Omni Local API ECHONET Lite (Japanese home-appliance and HEMS LAN protocol)Current standard: the ECHONET Consortium publishes Lite spec Ver.1.14 and APPENDIX Release R rev.4 in Japanese and English. C Fills the repo's Japan gap. The standard is published, so this is a link-don't-spec registry entry plus notes on vendor quirks.Caveat: Multicast group was not confirmed from a fetched source; verify it. Warn about setpoint writes on EV chargers, batteries and PV. LAN UDP port 3610, unicast and multicast notifications, to appliances and Wi-Fi adapters. Any phone on the LAN works. ECHONET Consortium specifications · pychonet library Eight Sleep Pod 3 (cover and hub)Subscription mandatory since February 2023; the 2025-10-20 AWS outage broke cooling. The promised offline mode had not shipped by January 2026. A Subscription-gated and cloud-dependent, but not phone-direct; three mature open firmwares exist, so a pointer or setup guide fits better than a spec.Caveat: Any UART spec controls bed heating and cooling: state temperature limits and fail-safe behaviour. Name vendor processes by role only. Only after a hardware mod: open the Pod, add an SSH key via the microSD card, then run open firmware exposing MQTT or HTTP on the LAN. opensleep open firmware · podd replacement firmware Electronic shelf labels (SoluM, Hanshow) via OpenEPaperLinkSoluM and Hanshow vendor status unverified; tags reach hobbyists as retail surplus with no consumer cloud. OpenEPaperLink is actively maintained. C The OEPL access-point HTTP API runs on added ESP32 hardware and is already in the OEPL wiki, so link it. A Gicisky BLE spin-off fits better.Caveat: OpenEPaperLink is CC BY-NC-SA: cite it, never copy it. Check spin-off repo licences before any clean-room citation. Only after reflashing, via a self-built ESP32 access point over HTTP. Phone-direct: stock Gicisky/PickSmart BLE tags and Hanshow tags reflashed to ATC_BLE_OEPL. OEPL wiki: image upload · OEPL BLE communication eQ-3 Homematic / Homematic IP via CCU3, OpenCCU and HCUJuly 2025: eQ-3 will add new products to CCU3 until end of 2026, then hand development to the community OpenCCU from 2027. The HCU is the successor. B The hub API is vendor-documented and has a strong open-source successor. The 2027 handover makes it risk B, but the docs are public, so linking is enough.Caveat: This is a hub API only. The 868 MHz HmIP radio cannot be reached from a phone, and setups with only the Access Point are cloud-only. A phone on the LAN calls the CCU/OpenCCU XML-RPC or JSON-RPC API (firewall allowlisting needed), or the HCU Connect API WebSocket in developer mode. eQ-3 XML-RPC specification · Homematic IP Connect API EyezOn EnvisaLink EVL-3, EVL-4 and Uno (DSC, Honeywell panels)Active as of 2026-09: EVL4 and UNO still promoted, EnvisAlerts cloud tiers offered, no end-of-life notice. C Standard local bridge for legacy DSC and Honeywell alarm panels and a gap in the alarm category. The interface is vendor-documented, so a thin pointer entry.Caveat: Burglar-alarm interface: integration level only, no code-guessing or bypass. DSC and Honeywell dialects differ. Link the vendor doc once a URL is confirmed. LAN TCP port 4025 by default: password login, then keypad-emulation command and event socket for arm, disarm, zone and partition status. Home Assistant Envisalink integration · pyenvisalink library FRITZ!Box Smart Home (FRITZ!Smart Energy/Thermo, ex-FRITZ!DECT)Active. AVM renamed itself Fritz! in July 2025. Smart-Home REST API docs are dated 2025-08-07; the AHA-HTTP doc is now frozen. C Germany's dominant router and DECT smart-home ecosystem has nothing in the repo. The interfaces are vendor-published, so a thin link-out stub is the right size.Caveat: Link the REST API as primary and AHA-HTTP/TR-064 as legacy. The phone reaches only the box; the DECT ULE radio is not reachable from a phone. Fully local and vendor-supported: HTTP/SOAP on the LAN to the FRITZ!Box (REST API, AHA-HTTP, TR-064 on port 49000). The box relays to its DECT ULE devices. FRITZ! interface documentation index · fritzconnection TR-064/AHA client Frontier Silicon Venice-module internet radios (FSAPI; UNDOK/OKTIV)No shutdown confirmed; the claimed brand app and portal closures are unsourced. Home Assistant supports any radio UNDOK or OKTIV can see. B One module behind dozens of radio brands; promoting the existing unvalidated research note to a thin validated spec is cheap and wide-reaching.Caveat: Already written up in FSAPI.md and fsapi-tools; link those rather than presenting this as new reverse engineering. HTTP GET to the XML FSAPI on port 80 (some models 2244) with a PIN session, default 1234; SSDP discovery. Older firmware allows one session. flammy/fsapi with FSAPI.md · fsapi-tools docs Futurehome Smarthub (Norway), FIMP over MQTTFuturehome AS bankrupt 2025-05-20; relaunched by FHSD Connect AS with mandatory subscription from 2025-06-26 (community-sourced). A Class A behind a subscription. FIMP is vendor-documented, so mostly link-don't-spec; a short note on local broker access and root route is worthwhile.Caveat: Subscription gating comes from Consumer Rights Wiki citing an unreachable vendor FAQ. Root path fails phone-direct. Devices fall under existing zwave/zigbee coverage. LAN MQTT to the hub broker (port 1884 per futurehome2mqtt), reportedly disabled without subscription. Otherwise hardware root and Z-Wave JS only. Vendor FIMP protocol docs · futurehome2mqtt HA add-on Glowforge laser cutters (Basic, Plus, Pro)Went through an Assignment for the Benefit of Creditors in 2025; co-founders bought back the assets on 6 Nov 2025 and restarted. B Link, don't spec: the only local path is a community replacement firmware with its own documentation; the stock device has no local protocol.Caveat: ForgeFIRM is beta and drives a laser, so carry its safety warning. The Grbl transport (TCP or websocket) is unconfirmed. Stock firmware is cloud-only. Community ForgeFIRM (beta) gives a LAN web panel and Grbl interface, but installing it needs a PC serial console. ForgeFIRM documentation · openglow-org/forgefirm Hive hub, heating, View cameras and Leak SensorHive View cameras and HomeShield ended 1 Aug 2025; Leak Sensor 1 Sep 2023; Nano 1 Hub 1 Aug 2023. Heating continues. B Only the heating gear has a local path, already covered by Zigbee2MQTT converters; it merits a candidates-page link and pairing-reset note, not a full spec.Caveat: Zigbee is not phone-direct for the repo's app. A search-snippet claim of RTSP on the camera homebase is unverified and excluded. Hub has no local API. SLR1/SLR2 receivers and SLT2/SLT3 thermostats can be reset and paired to a third-party Zigbee coordinator (Zigbee2MQTT). Zigbee2MQTT: Hive SLR2 · Zigbee2MQTT: Hive SLT3 Honeywell Home / Resideo Wi-Fi thermostats (TCC, Lyric T5/T6, T9/T10)Active; Resideo still sells the Honeywell Home line and runs the TCC and Lyric clouds; no end-of-life notice found (unverified). C The only local path is Apple's published HAP. At most extend thermostat-cloud-locked-duds to name T5/T6, or a HomeKit-only note like ecobee's.Caveat: Do not write a protocol spec. Unverified whether HomeKit pairing works without first provisioning Wi-Fi through the Resideo app. HomeKit (HAP) only on T5/T6 and later; some users report read-only set-points. TCC-only models (RTH958x, TH9320WF) have no local path. HA forum: Lyric with homekit_controller · TechRadar Lyric T6R review Humane Ai PinHP bought Humane's assets; all Ai Pins went offline at 12:00 PT on 2025-02-28 and user data was deleted. A Risk-A device, but the local path is an openly documented community firmware stack, not a protocol a phone speaks; the catalogue can only link to it.Caveat: Never reproduce the leaked Humane ADB certificate or firmware. Revisit only if PenumbraOS companion apps define a phone-to-pin API. No device protocol. PenumbraOS is a whole-OS jailbreak over ADB using CVE-2024-31317, needing interposer hardware and a web installer. PenumbraOS findings on Ai Pin · PenumbraOS pinitd rootless init Keiser M Series bikes (M3i, M3i-TBT, M3iX, M5i)Active vendor. Its Developer Zone publishes the broadcast format and an MIT-licensed reference parser. Use is bound by Keiser's API Agreement. C First-party docs and an official parser exist and nothing is cloud-gated, so link rather than spec. A spec would be a small non-FTMS broadcast example.Caveat: The M3i Studio speaks standard FTMS, which is already covered. Follow Keiser's API Agreement and brand guidelines: cite, do not copy. The phone passively scans for advertisements named 'M3' and decodes the manufacturer data. No connection, pairing, account or cloud. Keiser M Series direct communication · Official Keiser BLE parser Kuri home robotProduction stopped 2018; Mayfield Robotics ceased operations by 2018-10-31, first opening SSH/ROS access and publishing developer docs. A Phone-direct BLE onboarding for an orphaned robot, documented by the vendor, so a spec would mainly paraphrase it; the preorder-only install base keeps priority low.Caveat: Paraphrase the vendor doc; do not copy UUIDs without attribution. The encrypted-password option is unexplained; companion-app availability unverified. Vendor-published BLE onboarding API: commands to list networks, connect, read status and version; then SSH and ROS over Wi-Fi. Kuri docs: BLE API · KuriRobot/Kuri-Documentation LEGO Powered Up / BOOST / Duplo hubs (LWP3) and SPIKE Prime / 51515MINDSTORMS discontinued 2022-12-31; Robot Inventor 51515 app support promised through 2024, now lapsed. Powered Up still active (not sourced). A Large installed base in homes and schools. Both protocols are vendor-published, so this is a link entry plus a hub-quirks note.Caveat: SPIKE Prime and 51515 hubs do not speak LWP3 on stock firmware; link both vendor docs. Phone-direct BLE GATT. Powered Up hubs speak LWP3 v3.0.00; stock SPIKE Prime and 51515 hubs use the SPIKE Prime protocol. LEGO Wireless Protocol 3 docs · LEGO SPIKE Prime protocol docs Logitech Circle 2 / Circle View camera and doorbellCircle 2 discontinued but still supported, with no cloud end date found (unverified). Logitech said in July 2024 Circle View remains in production. B The local path is Apple's vendor-published HAP, so link it rather than write a device spec; a HAP platform spec would be a separate, larger item.Caveat: Open-source HAP controller support for camera snapshots or streaming is unverified. HomeKit Secure Video recording needs iCloud+ and a home hub. HomeKit Accessory Protocol over IP on the LAN: Circle 2 pairs with a setup code alongside the Circle app; Circle View is HomeKit-only. Logitech: Circle 2 with HomeKit · 9to5Mac: Logitech not discontinuing Mysa smart thermostats (Baseboard, In-Floor, Mini-Split AC)Healthy, still shipping; Matter pairing documented (app 4.18+). March 2025 cloud MQTT authorisation flaw patched in about 28 hours. C Link, don't spec: the local path is HomeKit and Matter, both published standards. A short device entry pointing to HAP/Matter pairing is enough.Caveat: Which models (Lite, In-Floor, AC) expose HomeKit locally is unverified; mysotherm reports no local network API. Wi-Fi units pair locally as HomeKit (HAP over IP) accessories; newer firmware adds Matter. The proprietary MQTT/REST protocol is cloud-only. mysotherm cloud protocol RE · HA community: Mysa via HomeKit Nanoleaf panels (Aurora, Canvas, Shapes, Elements, Lines)OneRobotics announced its acquisition of loss-making Nanoleaf on 2026-05-15: about $40.5M across four closings over 24 months. B Vendor-documented OpenAPI, so link, don't spec. A thin spec pinning pairing, port and token lifecycle hedges against the acquisition removing the docs.Caveat: The hold is 5-7 seconds; 30 seconds is the pairing window. Essentials lines are Matter/Thread and out of scope. Wi-Fi LAN HTTP REST: hold the power button 5-7 seconds, POST to create a token, then read and write state, effects and layout. nanoleafapi OpenAPI documentation · Postman collection mirroring OpenAPI Onkyo / Pioneer / Integra AV receivers (eISCP)Onkyo Home Entertainment filed for bankruptcy 2022-05-13; Premium Audio Company (Sharp JV) acquired Onkyo and Integra in 2021 and licenses Pioneer. B A vendor-published protocol with a maintained machine-readable command set already; a spec would duplicate it. At most a link-out stub.Caveat: The vendor spec PDF is community-hosted: link it, never commit it. eISCP does not rescue the cloud streaming features. Fully local: unauthenticated plain TCP socket on the LAN for power, volume, input and status; needs Network Standby enabled. onkyo-eiscp command set · Integra ISCP vendor PDF Polar H10 / Verity Sense (Polar Measurement Data)Active. Polar maintains the official BLE SDK (release 8.3.0) with its PMD specification. Supported devices include the H10, H9, Verity Sense, OH1, 360 and Loop. C The vendor publishes the PMD spec and a maintained SDK, and base heart rate is standard HRS. A short link entry is enough.Caveat: The SDK is under Polar's own licence. Link the PMD PDF; do not reproduce it. Phone-direct BLE to the strap: subscribe to the standard Heart Rate Service and write PMD start-measurement commands. No cloud. Polar PMD specification PDF · Polar official BLE SDK Ring Alarm (base station gen 1/2, Alarm Pro, Z-Wave sensors, Keypad G2)Active and sold; Ring's support docs confirm Alarm devices use Z-Wave to the base station. Monitoring needs a Ring Protect subscription. C Re-inclusion uses standard Z-Wave command classes that Ring documents in its own technical manuals, so link them. Not phone-direct; vendor is healthy.Caveat: Needs a separate Z-Wave controller, not a phone. Ring's docs confirm the gen-1 base station does use Z-Wave. Base station: none, cloud only. Sensors and Keypad G2 are standard Z-Wave and can be re-included into another controller, abandoning Ring. Ring: Z-Wave and mesh networks · Ring Retrofit Kit Z-Wave manual Shelly relays, plugs, dimmers and EM (Gen1 to Gen4)Healthy: H1 2026 revenue was EUR 68.3M (+26.5%). The cloud is optional. Gen1 firmware is frozen at about 1.14.x; Gen2+ still gets features. C The vendor docs are thorough and current, and Home Assistant supports Shelly locally. A full spec would duplicate them; at most write a thin family profile.Caveat: Do not transcribe the API reference. A thin profile linking the vendor docs is the most to write. Keep an eye on Gen1's frozen firmware. Fully local on the LAN. Gen1 uses HTTP REST and CoIoT/CoAP. Gen2+ uses JSON-RPC over HTTP /rpc or WebSocket. Discovery is by mDNS or CoAP. Shelly Gen2+ API docs · Shelly Gen2+ Shelly component Solarman (IGEN) V5 Wi-Fi logger sticks (Deye, Sofar, Solis...)IGEN/Solarman appears active with a working cloud; whether logger firmware updates close port 8899 is unverified. (unverified) C One stick protocol unlocks many hybrid inverters (Deye, Sunsynk, Sol-Ark). Framing is already written up (community-documented), so mostly link, don't spec; add per-brand profiles.Caveat: Do not transcribe vendor Deye/Sofar register PDFs; document reads and keep writes to user-facing settings, with a grid and battery warning. TCP 8899 to the logger stick: Modbus RTU wrapped in V5 frames keyed by the logger serial. Not Solis S3-WIFI-ST or Ethernet sticks. pysolarmanv5 V5 protocol write-up · pysolarmanv5 library Specialized Turbo e-bikes (TCU1 / TCX1-TCX4)Active vendor (unverified). TCX2+ per-bike keys come from Specialized's cloud keystore; Home Assistant core support added in 2026.9. C Already well documented by an MIT protocol.md and Home Assistant core: link rather than re-spec, adding a short note urging owners to escrow keys.Caveat: Never reproduce the app wrapping key or how it was extracted (anti-circumvention); state only that a per-bike key is required. BLE GATT for telemetry and settings writes; encrypted TCX2+ bikes need a one-time per-bike key fetched with a Specialized account, or the wrapped key. specialized-turbo protocol.md · specialized-turbo Python library SunPower PVS5 / PVS6 monitoring gateway (+ SunVault)Chapter 11 filed 2024-08-05; SunStrong Management now runs the legacy fleet and has published an official local API. Subscription price unverified. A Link SunStrong's official doc; spec only the community-only parts: legacy device list, installer-port and hotspot access, build cutover, telemetry WebSocket.Caveat: Do not spec SunVault control via MQTT redirect. Poll at 120 s or more. Placeholder serials, since the password derives from them. LAN HTTP: vendor-documented varserver API with owner auth on new firmware; legacy unauthenticated device list; 1 s telemetry WebSocket; hotspot after power cycle. SunStrong official LocalAPI doc · koleson PVS6 notes Tablo OTA DVR (legacy network models and 4th gen)Owned by E. W. Scripps since 2022; 4th gen relies on the Lighthouse cloud. Claimed 2026-09-01 legacy app removal unverified. B Legacy API already has a written community reference, so link it. 4th gen is a parked cloud-dependent research item.Caveat: Never publish the 4th-gen static signing keys taken from the vendor app; describe the signing scheme only abstractly. Legacy models: unauthenticated local REST on :8885 with UDP broadcast discovery, fully phone-direct. 4th gen: signed requests plus cloud tokens, no cloud-free path. Unofficial Tablo API docs · tablo-api 4th-gen Python client WHOOP 4.0 strap (5.0 / MG partial)Tracking requires a subscription; 5.0/MG launched May 2025 with an upgrade fee, reversed around 2025-05-10. A Subscription-gated wearable; 4.0 already has a clean community write-up, so link it with a short summary spec. The 5.0/MG gap is the follow-up.Caveat: Link, don't re-spec 4.0. Exclude MG ECG and blood-pressure features, which are FDA-regulated or disputed. Phone bonds directly over BLE (custom service 61080002-…, plus standard Heart Rate). No auth observed; live HR, history offload and alarm work offline. whoopsie-protocol WHOOP 4.0 BLE spec · Reverse-engineering WHOOP write-up Xbox One SmartGlass local protocolStart-by-TitleID removed around April 2019; core Python library archived 2021-10-20; Home Assistant now uses the cloud (community-sourced). B Vendor and ecosystem are dropping the local path. OpenXbox already documents it cleanly, so link it; a spec only preserves discovery and power-on in repo format.Caveat: Series X|S behaviour and current app use are unverified. Stay away from Nano gamestream content protection, DRM and anti-cheat. Same-LAN UDP discovery and power-on, then an encrypted SmartGlass channel set (input, media, text, TV) straight from the phone. OpenXbox SmartGlass documentation · smartglass-documentation source

docs.title: Parked: no local path
docs.text:
Notable orphans and at-risk devices with no local control path. RE here yields a self-hosted cloud replacement at best, which the older page explains is a different project. They are recorded so nobody re-surveys them. Where the cloud still answers, capturing app↔cloud traffic now is the only cheap insurance.

Device Risk Status Why it is parked Public work Amazon Cloud Cam A Service ended 2022-12-02; owners were offered a free Blink Mini. In June 2025 AWS published unpatched CVE-2025-6031, saying it should not be used. No local path. No public write-up, firmware dump, root guide or RTSP/ONVIF path; the CVE pairing flaw is the only lead. The camera has an unpatched network-hijack flaw (CVE-2025-6031); any future spec must carry a safety warning. None public yet · status source Nest Secure (Guard, Detect, Tag) and Nest x Yale Lock A Nest Secure support ended 2024-04-08. Nest x Yale sales ended 2025-03 with no published end-of-support date; Guard owners got Nest Connect. None. Nest Secure needs Weave per-device secrets that OpenWeave does not ship. Nest x Yale falls back to its keypad; no local API, Matter or HomeKit. Treat the lock's radio stack as unverified; the Gadget Hacks 'proprietary protocol, not Thread or Weave' claim is unreliable. openweave-core · Google: Nest x Yale after Secure SNOO Smart Sleeper bassinet A Active vendor; features paywalled July 2024 ($19.99/mo, units bought before 2024-07-15 grandfathered). Backend moved from PubNub to MQTT in Aug 2025. None. Pairing is over Wi-Fi, not Bluetooth; all public RE talks to the vendor cloud. Offline, only the physical Activity button works. device-candidates.md still lists PubNub as the Snoo transport; the Aug 2025 MQTT migration makes that out of date. python-snoo current cloud client · HA PR: Snoo PubNub to MQTT Whistle GPS pet trackers (Go Explore, Fit, Switch) A Service shut down 31 Aug 2025 after Tractive bought Whistle; owners could claim a free Tractive replacement until 30 Sep 2025. No local path. GPS and health data go to the cloud over LTE-M; BLE appears limited to setup and phone proximity. The only public teardown is of the older pre-GPS activity monitor, not these GPS models. Whistle (company) on Wikipedia · Adafruit teardown (pre-GPS model) Canary security cameras (Pro, View, Flex) B Still operating; subscription-tiered but not bricked. Free tier keeps motion clips and 24h history; Premium is $19.99/mo (2026 review). None found. Integrations are cloud polling with cloud live streams; BLE only provisions Wi-Fi at setup and is undocumented. The BLE setup fact comes from search snippets of help pages that return 403; BLE provisioning gives no control or stream. Home Assistant Canary integration · py-canary cloud API client Meta Portal (Portal+, Mini, Go, TV) B Sales ended 2022-12-31; no new features, apps phased out gradually, calling continues. Wikipedia reports devices usable until February 2032. No local path. Retail bootloader unlock needs an internal Facebook tool; no LAN or BLE control protocol is documented. Zoom/Alexa end dates (2025-01-31) and photo-frame removal (January 2026) come from uncited sites; treat them as unverified. XDA Portal locked bootloader thread · XDA Portal ROMs published (closed) Nanit Plus / Pro baby camera B Active vendor. From Jan 2025 owners report setup requires an Insights plan; MFA is now mandatory, forcing community clients to adapt. Cloud-gated. Community clients use a protobuf WebSocket, locally too, but camera address and uc_token come from the cloud; cameras can refuse local clients. The community .proto files are other people's derived work: cite them, do not import them. gregory-m/nanit stream proxy · aionanit cloud and local client Nixplay Wi-Fi smart photo frames B Active, but on 21 Apr 2025 cut free storage from 10GB to 500MB and removed free Google Photos sync. No local path on stock firmware. Jailbreaks (rkflashtool or adb from a PC) replace the vendor software; older non-Smart NIX frames play from USB/SD. Worth at most one candidates-page line linking the jailbreak write-ups; do not reproduce their partition offsets or patched init details. Jailbreak a Nixplay W10P · Nixplay W13D frame hacking SkyBell HD / Trim / Gen5 video doorbells B Legacy SkyBell HD app shut down 2025-03-03 (announced 2024-06-30); the Gen5 update removes all third-party access. Company still operates. None. All app traffic goes through the cloud; the doorbell talks CoAP (presumably over DTLS) to the vendor cloud, which also proxies live SRTP. Public RE predates Gen5 and no longer works. Retirement dates come from a support-page snippet that returns 403. homebridge-skybell protocol overview · homebridge-skybell cloud HTTPS protocol Traeger WiFIRE pellet grills B Active but strained: Q2 2026 revenue $120.2M, down 17.4% year on year; about $400M long-term debt; guidance lowered (8-K, 5 Aug 2026). No local path. Control goes through AWS IoT MQTT; a 2024 port scan found nothing open, and BLE only sets up Wi-Fi. The candidates page's BLE exception looks wrong: Traeger describes BLE as Wi-Fi setup only. Do not cite the 2019 daemonp gist. MakeWithData Traeger teardown · homeassistant-traeger cloud client Netatmo Weather Station, Smart Thermostat, Welcome/Presence cameras C Active, still sold and supported; the official API is cloud-only, and a community request for a local API remains open. Parked: the camera LAN stream needs a key the cloud issues and re-issues every few hours, the thermostat only exposes a standard HomeKit subset, and the weather station uplink is encrypted to the cloud. Without the cloud a new camera key cannot be bootstrapped, and the remote URL expires after 3 h or a reboot. Netatmo Security API reference · HA issue: Presence LAN stream Segway Navimow robot mowers C Active and investing: ships an official cloud-based Home Assistant integration (NavimowHA, needs HA 2026.1+) and a Python SDK. No local path. The community developer confirmed in August 2026 there is no local communication; no public BLE GATT RE was found. Keep separate from the ninebot-segway-ble scooter spec: same parent company, different product and protocol. HA forum: no local communication · navimow-sdk cloud SDK Sensibo Sky / Air / Air Pro AC controller (IR blaster) C Active and healthy; Sky, Air, Air Pro, Pure and Elements still sold and supported. No EOL notice found. No local API on stock firmware. Air Pro offers HomeKit (mode and setpoint only, one controller). Sky needs case opening and serial ESPHome reflash. Sensibo documents HomeKit only for Air Pro; plain Air support is unverified. Sky is ESP8266EX, not ESP32. Homebridge/Matter plugins use the cloud. Reflash Sensibo Sky with ESPHome · Removing cloud from Sensibo Sky Tile and Chipolo Bluetooth item trackers C Healthy: Life360 is launching new Tile lines in 2026 with an SOS feature; Chipolo still sells the Chipolo ONE. No usable local path: ringing a Tile needs a per-device authkey from the account. No public Chipolo command RE, only advertisement presence. Never help track other people's tags from rotating advertisement IDs; any revisit is ring-your-own-tag only, after a safety review. node-tile Tile protocol doc · Tile protocol security analysis

docs.title: Already half-written: graduate these research notes
docs.text:
These devices are not missing from the repo so much as stuck in it: each has an unvalidated write-up under research-notes/ that never became a spec. A triage of all the notes picked these 25 as the best value, weighing risk, installed base, a genuine local path, and how much of the work is already done. Scrub first marks a note that the triage says names vendor-app internals. Paraphrase those before anything moves into device-specs/devices/.

Note Device Risk Maturity Value Why, and what is missing research-notes/daikin-wifi-adapters.md Daikin Wi-Fi adapters BRP069A4x / BRP069B41 / BRP072 (and key-auth BRP069C4x) B near-spec high Large mini-split base. Daikin already dropped the local API from Onecta-era adapters, so installed units are the at-risk ones. Missing: per-family enum tables, the BRP069C4x auth exchange, discovery bytes. research-notes/frontier-silicon-radio.md Frontier Silicon / Frontier Smart FSAPI internet radios (Hama, TechniSat, Roberts, Revo, Medion, SilverCrest, Teufel, Como Audio and more) B near-spec high Millions of radios under dozens of brands, still LAN-controllable after the brand apps die. Missing: the node tree with value enums, port variance, the single-session limit. Also in Link, don't spec: a clean community write-up exists. research-notes/green-mountain-grills.md Green Mountain Grills Wi-Fi pellet grills (Daniel Boone, Jim Bowie, Ledge/Peak, Trek) C near-spec high Unauthenticated LAN UDP, written up only across several hobby clients. Missing: the full status-reply field map, newer-firmware checks. Live-fire safety: keep the fan cooldown and clamp setpoints. research-notes/meural-canvas.md Netgear Meural Canvas I & II (MC315/MC321/MC327) B near-spec high Netgear ended the line in 2024. The frame serves its own local endpoints. Missing: the upload multipart schema, key values, response schemas, and setting up a frame that was never cloud-paired. research-notes/neurometrix-quell.md NeuroMetrix Quell / Quell 2.0 wearable TENS A near-spec high Quell 2.0 is discontinued and the one-button unit is app-only. Missing: command byte order, status layout, bonding. Scrub first: the note names vendor-app internals. Expose only the app's own intensity commands. research-notes/qardio-arm.md QardioArm (A100) blood pressure monitor A near-spec high Qardio went bankrupt and the cloud has been down since 2025-04-29. Small spec: SIG Blood Pressure service plus a two-command vendor characteristic. Missing: advert name, the bonding-error reset quirk. research-notes/samsung-wam-multiroom.md Samsung Wireless Audio Multiroom (WAM / Radiant360 R1-R7, M-series soundbars, WAM hubs) A near-spec high Discontinued 2014–2017 speakers. The only command reference is a community extraction. Missing: a core command subset, response schemas, grouping semantics, onboarding without the app. research-notes/boosted-boards.md Boosted Boards (V1-V3, Mini S/X, Plus, Stealth, Boosted Rev) A substantial high Liquidated 2020. The GATT map is recovered. Missing: value encodings, the auth challenge, the Rev variant. Scrub first: the note carries vendor-app internal names. Safety HIGH: never document mode or speed-limit writes. Also in the mobility table. research-notes/fujitsu-fglair.md Fujitsu FGLair / Ayla-platform Wi-Fi AC modules (UTY-TFSXW1/3; HiSense AEH-W4x rebadges: Beko, Westinghouse, York) B substantial high The Ayla LAN mode covers several AC brands. Keys can be pulled only while the Ayla cloud still answers, so this is time-boxed. Missing: handshake, key derivation, property tables. research-notes/generic-ble-tpms-caps.md Generic BLE TPMS cap sensors (SYTPMS / TPMSII / ITPMS-LYTPMS / Michelin TMS families) C substantial high Passive-advert tyre sensors sold under throwaway apps. Only one of the four formats is written up. Missing: the other layouts, the status bitfield, the wheel mapping. research-notes/insteon-hub.md Insteon Hub 2245-222 (v2) / 2242-222 (v1) A substantial high The cloud died without warning in April 2022 and LAN control survived. Missing: a transcribed PLM command/response table, the buffer poll-and-clear sequence, and discovery. Also in Do these next. research-notes/joule-sous-vide.md ChefSteps / Breville Joule sous vide (incl. Joule Turbo) B substantial high No physical controls, and the legacy app has been retired for Breville+. Missing: GATT UUIDs and stream framing. Clean-room: a public source republished decompiled .proto files, so paraphrase field meanings and never copy the proto text. research-notes/neato-botvac-d-series.md Neato Botvac Connected / D3-D7 A substantial high Cloud shut down Q4 2025. The serial side is mature but needs an ESP32. The phone-direct HTTPS surface is mapped only as far as the info endpoint. Also in the robots table. research-notes/dts-play-fi.md DTS Play-Fi (Phorus) speakers: Polk, Definitive Technology, Klipsch Stream, Onkyo/Pioneer, MartinLogan, SVS and others B thin high Large multi-brand base already losing features. Only discovery and UPnP are known, and the control channel is open. Scrub first: vendor-app internal names in the note. research-notes/hestan-cue.md Hestan Cue induction burner + smart cookware A thin high App retired 2025-07-21, and no community RE exists anywhere. Only UUIDs are known. Start with a read-only thermometer spec after a capture. Scrub the vendor enum names from the note. research-notes/level-lock.md Level Lock (Bolt / Lock / Lock+) B thin high ASSA ABLOY reportedly gutted the team. The working path is HomeKit/Matter, so a graduated spec is mostly a migration guide with vendor UUID stubs. Also in the locks table. research-notes/hydrao-smart-shower.md HYDRAO smart shower heads (First, Aloe) A near-spec medium Vendor in liquidation since 2026-06-02. Self-powered, no cloud needed. Missing: the temperature-characteristic discrepancy, threshold writes, history record format. research-notes/meross-msg100.md Meross appliance protocol (MSG100 garage opener as exemplar; same envelope across Meross plugs and switches) C near-spec medium Best graduated as a Meross platform spec (like tuya-generic-device), with the garage opener as the worked example. Missing: the namespace catalogue and local key provisioning. Also in the switches and hubs table. research-notes/neurio-w1-hem.md Neurio W1-HEM / Generac PWRview home energy monitor A near-spec medium Generac ended support on 2025-03-10. The local endpoint is vendor-documented, but on a dead product's domain, so graduating preserves it. Small, fast spec. Missing: local Wi-Fi reconfiguration. research-notes/parrot-zik.md Parrot Zik 1 / 2.0 / 3 headphones A near-spec medium Parrot left consumer audio. The API lives in one client. Was blocked on a Bluetooth Classic protocol value; bluetooth_classic landed 2026-09-27, and iOS still cannot open SPP. Scrub first: vendor-app internal names in the note. research-notes/bowflex-selecttech-560.md BowFlex SelectTech 560 smart dumbbells A substantial medium BowFlex went through Chapter 11 in 2024 and the app is gone. The GATT table is recovered. Missing: notification formats, the challenge handshake. Scrub first: characteristics are labelled with vendor codenames. research-notes/jawbone-jambox.md Jawbone Jambox / Big Jambox / Mini Jambox A substantial medium Jawbone was liquidated in 2017 and there is no public client. Was blocked on a Bluetooth Classic protocol value; bluetooth_classic landed 2026-09-27. Scrub first: the note quotes vendor-app internals. research-notes/nuraphone.md Nura Nuraphone / NuraLoop / NuraTrue A substantial medium Discontinued after the 2023 acquisition. The key-provisioning backend is the single point of failure. Was blocked on a Bluetooth Classic protocol value; bluetooth_classic landed 2026-09-27. Scrub first: internal names in the note. research-notes/pentair-screenlogic.md Pentair ScreenLogic / ScreenLogic2 protocol adapter (IntelliTouch / EasyTouch / SunTouch) C substantial medium Costly pool automation. The protocol lives only in node-screenlogic / screenlogicpy. Missing: header layout, message codes, login hash, status decoding. Healthy vendor, so local-first value. research-notes/wink-hub.md Wink Hub v1 / Wink Hub 2 A substantial medium Subscription-extortion archetype. The stock local API needs a cloud token, and the durable path is rooting. Graduate it as a documented dud plus a migration guide for the attached Z-Wave/Zigbee devices.

docs.title: Corrections this survey found in existing pages
docs.text:
• research-notes/thermostat-cloud-locked-duds.md rejects the Mitsubishi Kumo Cloud adapters (PAC-USWHS002/003) as cloud-only. pykumo and the Kumo Home Assistant integration drive them over a local API. The Kumo row above has the details.
  • Candidate Devices, Anova Generation 2: the Precision Cooker Mini does not use the Nano's COBS + protobuf framing. It has its own BLE service with JSON payloads Base64-encoded (vendor docs). In Generation 3, the Wi-Fi WebSocket is a cloud endpoint, not a LAN one (bogd/anova-oven-api), and the awgneo/anova-homeassistant repository that page cites no longer resolves.

docs.title: Weekly Device Sweeps
docs.text:
Every week the catalogue gets a short sweep: a few devices from the backlog become validated specs, and the news since the last sweep is searched for devices that are newly dying (cloud shutdowns, bankruptcies, withdrawn apps, new paywalls, firmware that removes local access) or newly popular, where local control is reasonably achievable. The backlog is Missing Devices; this page is the dated log on top of it.

Like the survey, each entry is a snapshot. Grep device-specs/devices/, research-notes/ and targets/ before starting on anything listed here. Claims marked unverified rest on a search snippet or a page that would not load, and need checking before they go into a spec.

A research consolidation pass over the latest local captures and recovered apps. Two protocols are ready for the catalogue, one existing spec needed a correction, and several tempting targets still need a different transport or better evidence rather than a premature app claim.

docs.title: Added this week
docs.text:
Spec Origin Notes Artiphon Orba 2 research-notes/artiphon-orba.* + new Orba 2 app/protocol research Corrects the old note's Orba-1 scope: the capture-verified map is Orba 2, with the recovered com.artiphon.kestrel companion. Standard BLE-MIDI, LSB-first 7-bit SysEx packing, zero-init CRC-16 and fragmented writes. Transport, quantization, tempo and FX; destructive erase commands are advanced. scripts/test_artiphon_orba_2_spec.py. Petronics Mousr research-notes/mousr-cat-toy.* + recovered 1.0.7 app Fifteen-byte command envelope, decimal command IDs (the second byte of a one-digit code is unresolved), Nordic UART and three-float32-LE drive vectors. Stop and chirp are fixed commands; movement is advanced and drive units/ranges stay unclaimed. Notifications and auto-mode layouts remain open. scripts/test_petronics_mousr_spec.py.

The schema now carries float32 for fields and command parameters, closing the gap previously recorded for Hot Wheels and Mousr, and names the orba_sysex_ble_midi framing scheme.

docs.title: Corrections and research-note updates
docs.text:
• Hot Wheels id Race Portal: the recovered official app identifies the 000a service as MPID session setup and 000b as signed-image OTA. The manufacturing token is variable-length per the app analysis (136-byte generation one, at least 182 bytes in another format). The community note's 148-byte read is kept as an observation from its unit; it matches neither format and is unexplained. The read-only community control path remains valid and no official command write is offered. The speed field is now float32; its unit is still unresolved.
  • Wilson X: assigned to the fa10 three-axis family, not 94Fifty or the aa80/fd40 9-DoF variants. Mode-1 signed axes and mode-6 five-sample magnitudes are recorded in research-notes/wilson-x-basketball.*. Decoder selection needs hardware/firmware evidence, and offline first-run onboarding is unproven, so this is not yet an app spec.
  • Lattis Ellipse: mapped the V2 session, controls and sensors. Its challenge uses MD5/SHA-256, not AES. Existing account/lock records can work locally; fresh server-signed provisioning is the unsolved boundary. Do not send lock commands without a validated owner session.
  • Sleep Number: Fuzion and MCR are separate BLE protocols, not one bed API. Auth-before-notify, MCR address binding and movement cancellation are documented in a new research note. No motion UI until a read-only session and stop/cancel behavior are verified.
  • Eye-Fi: mapped the card-initiated HTTP/SOAP receiver on TCP 59278 and mounted-card configuration channel. A phone controller needs a secure LAN server, not an outbound camera client; legacy tar extraction is unsafe to copy. No app transport is added by this research alone.
  • Spotify Car Thing: bridgething now has a documented v2 MessagePack/JSON protocol over RFCOMM, iAP2 and WebSockets. Mira is standalone after custom firmware; stock firmware remains unrescued. Custom firmware is destructive, and this does not justify a stock-protocol app claim.
  • Decent Espresso DE1: the vendor already publishes the app and local BLE/LAN options; consolidate/link those first. Dreem 2 has prior-art raw-BLE streaming but still needs the write sequence and capture evidence. Pantelligent still lacks a GATT map and Lockitron Bolt lacks a proven local pairing/key path; neither gains an invented spec.

docs.title: Additional research integrations
docs.text:
A second pass over the newly validated research packs added two receive/read protocols and corrected two existing specs. All four remain untested on hardware by this project; passing upstream or synthetic checks are not relabelled as physical verification.

Spec Origin Notes Qingping / ClearGrass stock BLE sensors qingping-ble 1.3.0 parser and fixtures, 2026-11-01 Passive stock 0xFDCD service data, 20 model IDs, complete TLV framing and units. Corrects two older assumptions: CGDK2 is supported, and TLV 0x18 is a capability bitmap rather than CO2. Event packets update motion without overwriting illuminance. scripts/test_qingping_stock_ble_spec.py. Ecosense / FTLab RadonEye RD200 rd200v2 + radonpy, 2026-11-01 Both RD200 generations: V1 float32 pCi/L with command/length framing, configuration and chunked history; V2 exact-length uint16 Bq/m³ responses. Generation selection requires name plus GATT shape, no V1 opcode is reused on V2, and history erase is advanced. scripts/test_ecosense_radoneye_rd200_spec.py.
  • QardioArm: the standard Blood Pressure Measurement characteristic uses indications. Enable the update mechanism the characteristic actually exposes and wait for confirmation; the Android port's hard-coded notification CCCD write is not a protocol requirement. Its incomplete SFLOAT handling likewise remains a client limitation, not wire-format evidence.
  • WeatherFlow Tempest: completed the obs_st, legacy AIR/SKY, wind and lightning layouts. Tempest index 12 is rain over the previous minute, not a reporting-interval or daily total; short arrays and nulls stay unavailable. Added sensor-status bits and the lightning energy/distance quirks from the validated parser research.

docs.title: Added this week
docs.text:
Four of the survey's Do these next picks:

Spec Survey item Notes AM43 / A-OK Blind Motor #2 Every frame checked against the XOR rule; six match literal frames in am43-ctrl; scripts/test_am43_spec.py. No BLE command to set travel limits is public. Instant Pot Smart Bluetooth #1 Follows OpenPot's code where its README disagrees; every disagreement is in remaining_unknowns. scripts/test_instant_pot_spec.py. TiVo Network Remote #17 TCP 31339 remote only; Mind RPC is out of scope. TiVo's own PDF is offline, so facts come from openHAB and McBrine's client. Drobo NAS Status Daemon #15 Read-only. The 16-byte header layout rests on one owner's reading of a single 5N2.

One caveat on the survey's rows, found while writing them: the AM43 row says the Blind Engine app is off Google Play, which could not be confirmed either way. The Drobo row's "liquidated in 2023" is the Chapter 7 conversion of April 2023; the fuller timeline is Chapter 11 in June 2022 and the end of sales and support on 27 January 2023.

docs.title: New candidates
docs.text:
Not in the repo or the survey as of this date.

Orphaned or dying, with a local path

Device Status Risk Local path Public work Catch Bose Sleepbuds II Bose stopped offering the Sleep app on 2025-07-21 (Bose support). A Phone-direct BLE, one connection per bud: an audio service (fdc34961-888e-4a93-abf1-b3490d8b231b) and a settings service (0xfe21). SleepBuds2Revival No licence on the repo: derive facts only. Tested on one firmware. Keep sound upload and DFU out of scope. Äike T e-scooter Vendor bankrupt (nns.ee, 2026-01-06; The Register). A Phone-direct BLE with a SHA-1 challenge-response. nns.ee write-up Handle with care: the key is identical across the fleet, so a spec is also "unlock any Äike". Owner-held scooters only. Lexie and Eargo OTC hearing aids LXE Hearing is winding down US operations; Lexie's app and cloud were due off 2026-10-08, Eargo's 2026-10-22 (HearingTracker). Whether the 10-08 removal happened is unverified (the Play listing still resolved on 2026-10-11). A App v9 is said to keep working with its local on-device controls; whether that is a phone-direct Bluetooth link is not stated. None found Research target, and a medical device. The most time-sensitive item here: captures are only possible while v9 apps still work. Ampler e-bikes (Curt, Stout, Axel) Ampler Bikes OÜ filed for bankruptcy around 2026-05-15 (ERR News). A The app pairs over BLE; protocol unknown. None found Research target. Check first whether an existing drive spec already covers its electronics.

New or popular, with a local path

Device Status Risk Local path Public work Catch Besen BS20 EV charger Home Assistant core integration in 2026.9; CVE-2026-9394 (weak PIN requirements on the BLE handler), -9395 (credentials exposed over BLE and UDP) and -9398 (capture-replay authentication bypass), all on firmware up to 20260426. C BLE GATT ("ACP#"), 6-digit PIN that is often left at 123456. The UDP path on Wi-Fi rests on the CVE text only; the HA integration is BLE-only. HA besen integration Cap current at the wiring maximum; tell owners to change the PIN. Yarbo yard robot Active; May 2026 security flaws; an official "Open Platform" promised for early 2027. C Unauthenticated MQTT broker on the base station, TCP 1883. home-assistant-yarbo (MIT) Blades and auger: attended use only. The vendor may close the broker. ISEO Argo BLE locks HA core integration in 2026.9. C Phone-direct BLE with an EC key exchange; the client enrols with the physical master card. iseo-argo-ble Enrolment must be explicit and owner-only. Elegoo Centauri Carbon Active, very popular printer. C SDCP WebSocket (and HTTP upload) on TCP 3030, UDP discovery on 3000; the MJPEG stream's port (3031 in the docs' example) comes from the printer's reply. Centauri Carbon only: the CC2 reportedly uses MQTT 1883 and MJPEG on 8080 (unverified). OpenCentauri (MIT) Heaters: attended use. Nubert nuControl X-2 / nuPro X Active. C Phone-direct BLE, one connection. nubert-ble-homeassistant (MIT) Small; the author used AI-assisted RE, so re-check opcodes. Marstek Venus C / D / E batteries Active. C Vendor "Open API" on UDP 30000, enabled per device with a community tool (Venus Monitor). ha-marstek-local-api Whether the vendor publishes the API is not established; if it does, link rather than spec. Power setpoints need limits. Mahle X35 / X35+ / X20 (ebikemotion) drives Active. C Phone-direct BLE, read-mostly (one write: a switch that powers the bike down). Tested on two bikes only. ha-mysmartbike_ble (MIT) Leave out any assist or speed-limit writes. Hot Spring spas (Connected Spa Kit 2) HA core integration in 2026.9. C Local polling of the home network adapter. HA hotspring integration Wire format undocumented; read the integration. Even Realities G1 / G2 glasses Active. C Phone-direct BLE. Gadgetbridge (G1); even-g2-protocol (G2 only) AGPL and unlicensed sources: derive facts only. Harbor Sleep baby monitor HA integration in 2026.8. C Mutual-TLS on the LAN with a client certificate exported from the app. HA integration Research target; never commit a captured certificate. Unitree Go2 robot dog Active. C Local WebRTC; per-device AES key on recent firmware. unitree_webrtc_connect Handle with care (locomotion). TRMNL e-ink display Active; the vendor supports bring-your-own-server. C Device polls a self-hosted HTTP server. TRMNL developers Vendor-documented: link, don't spec. LEGO SMART Play brick Launched 2026-03-01. C Encrypted BLE between bricks. Teardowns only Research target.

docs.title: Status changes to items already listed
docs.text:
• Neato Botvac: heise reported the cloud phase-out in the week of 2025-10-06 (heise), earlier than the survey's late-December date. Vorwerk's exchange programme (a Kobold VR7 for EU owners who bought since May 2023 and used the cloud features) is on Neato's own support site.
  • Melnor RainCloud: Home Assistant 2026.10 removed the integration because the cloud no longer responds (release notes), confirming the survey's April 2026 date.
  • SolarEdge: the same release dropped SolarEdge Local and added a core SolarEdge Modbus integration, which backs the survey's "Modbus TCP is the durable path". The entry should be re-scoped to Modbus.
  • Tesla Powerwall: a 2026-09-17 community report says local interfaces were disabled on the customer Wi-Fi after a Powerwall 2 to 3 swap (HA community); firmware version not given.
  • Sleep Number: the sale to SNBR Inc., an affiliate of Sleep Country Canada, was approved 2026-07-20 and closed 2026-07-31 (Davis Polk); the new owner's plans for the SleepIQ cloud are unknown.
  • Owlet Smart Sock 2: Owlet's own page now confirms the 2025-04-08 cutoff (Owlet support).
  • Wallbox: the restructuring plan became final in July 2026 after a new equity raise, easing the going-concern risk the survey cites.
  • Sense monitor (research-notes/sense-monitor.yaml): Sense's own help centre says consumer monitor sales ended 2025-12-31 or when stock ran out. Still cloud-only, so the note's verdict does not change.
  • TiVo: one-button and automatic SkipMode end 2026-11-02 in favour of a paid add-on with a 30-day trial (trade press, September 2026); the network remote is unaffected.
  • Enphase Envoy: a June 2026 Enphase community thread reports /api/v1/production and /api/v1/consumption stalling on firmware D8.3.5528 (an Envoy-S Metered, upgraded 2026-06-14; the page itself renders only as an error shell, so the detail is from the search snippet). The spec was observed on D8.3.5427; check on the next verification session.
  • Accell group (Haibike, Ghost, Raleigh, Lapierre, Winora) was declared bankrupt on 2026-08-11. Their bikes use Bosch, Yamaha or Shimano drives, so the drive specs are the relevant coverage.

docs.title: No local path
docs.text: Samsung's Korea-only SmartThings Tracker (service ends 2026-10-31), the Limitless pendant (Meta acquisition; no public protocol work), Meta Ray-Ban's paywalled Conversation Focus, Permobil wheelchairs (cloud API deprecated), Hookii Neomow mowers (vulnerabilities only, no supported path), Spectrum Home Security and Rad Power Bikes. Senec home batteries are a lead worth a targeted look: EnBW is winding down new sales, and a community LAN API on Senec.Home V3 is unverified.

docs.title: 2026-10-11 (second pass)
docs.text: A same-day second sweep, run after the first pass merged. It takes more of the survey's Do these next picks, turns three of last pass's candidates into specs, graduates one research note, and opens eight targets/ stubs for finds that have public work but no protocol write-up yet.

docs.title: Added this week
docs.text:
Five more of the survey's Do these next picks, one of last pass's new candidates, and one research note graduated. Every spec is testing: untested; byte-level facts from client code are reported.

Spec Survey item Notes Enel X Way JuiceBox #3 Plaintext JuiceNet UDP (v09u Gen 2, v07 Gen 1): 25-field status grammar, CMD reply with its 16-bit hash and base-35 check digits, telnet console on TCP 2000, three re-point routes (DNS override, router DNAT, telnet) each staged behind the SoftAP join. Both current commands advanced behind a safety_advisory: the charger clamps to its rating, not the wiring. The encrypted v09e/v08 firmware (June/Nov 2024) is recognised, not decoded. scripts/test_enel_x_juicebox_spec.py. Sengled Wi-Fi Smart Bulbs #5 Unauthenticated UDP 9080 JSON control (power, brightness, RGB, colour temperature 1-100, discovery broadcast); the setup-AP exchange at the bulb's fixed SoftAP address under RC4 with a fixed public key (device_encrypted); the stand-in-cloud replies and the wifielement/<MAC>/… MQTT vocabulary for a user-owned broker. Zigbee and BLE-mesh Sengled bulbs excluded. The brief's "WF863" model could not be verified; the Tasmota route is tied to ESP8266EX modules instead. Open: Kelvin endpoints of the 1-100 scale. scripts/test_sengled_wifi_bulb_spec.py. Yummly Smart Thermometer #7 XW2 (T1 dock + P1 probe): TLV service, one-byte challenge ping, probe frames with a reversed MAC, bit-rotation packing (20-bit core in 0.1 °F, 12-bit body in whole °F, 4-bit battery gauge) with 15 worked vectors, computed from the algorithm and labelled hypothesis. XW3 (T3 + P3) from the app only, marked untested in variants. Food-safety safety_advisory. App shutdown 2024-12-18 (RE repo), site and apps 2024-12-20. scripts/test_yummly_smart_thermometer_spec.py. Kano Coding Wand #16 Kano's own @kano/devices-sdk (MIT, npm, 2018) survives and names every UUID, so openness: documented_api; it settles the quaternion order (int16 LE, w x y z, ×1000) where two community clients disagree. Button, battery, vibration, RGB565 LED, keep-alive, orientation reset, magnetometer calibration, raw temperature, Nordic Secure DFU with both entry writes advanced. Administration 2023-06-06 (Gazette). Gesture recognition out of scope. scripts/test_kano_coding_wand_spec.py. Hot Wheels id Race Portal #18 Read-only: HWiD name, three services under one base UUID, indications for car UID, serial, NDEF car-ID token (21 bytes, base64url) and a float32 pass value whose physical unit is unconfirmed and stays raw. Mattel discontinued the id system 2023-12-31 (vendor FAQ). The authentication service is recorded as wire facts only. Laps are a client-side derivation. scripts/test_hot_wheels_id_race_portal_spec.py. Bose Sleepbuds II last pass's candidate One peripheral per bud: 12-byte Audio Data frame (play, stop, volume, timer), stored-sound list, clock sync, Settings flags and phone-free toggle, battery, Control Point opcodes (play-in-future, alarms, firmware queries). Sound upload and firmware activation under out_of_scope only. Link-layer security unknown at low confidence; the name matcher is low-confidence because no source recorded the factory name. Facts only from the unlicensed community client. QardioArm (A100) graduated from research-notes/qardio-arm.md SIG Blood Pressure service with a full SFLOAT, flags and status decode; vendor control bytes for start and cancel; Just-Works bond with the four ATT error codes that mean re-bond; pinhole bond reset as factory_reset and unpair. Medical safety_advisory. The original note's dates were loose: the app vanished about 2024-09-21 and returned, servers were intermittent from 2025-03-12 and down for good 2025-04-29. The research note stays as the dated trail. scripts/test_qardio_arm_spec.py.

Three schema gaps surfaced while writing them. One was closed in the same PR after review: advanced was not a declared key on network commands, so the JuiceBox current-limit flag validated only because command objects are open; the schema now carries the same advanced / advanced_reason contract there as on BLE commands and HTTP endpoints. Two remain, noted in the specs' remaining_unknowns: format.type has no float (Hot Wheels speed, Yummly XW3), and the BLE command vocabulary cannot express RGB565 packing (Kano set_color is unbound). Candidates for spec-evolution.

docs.title: Tracked for later (new targets/ stubs)
docs.text:
Each has public code or a dated shutdown but not enough published protocol to spec from; the stub records what is known and the first experiment.

Target Why Public work The gap fc-smarthome-lock Fingerchip / Fingercrystal fingerprint locks (FC SmartHome, Yi-Lock, eApartment, K3 apps). Risk C. fc-smart-home-assistant (MIT, 2026-09): 0xfc/0xfe framing, AES-128-ECB per-device key, locks dial TCP 4067 when woken. How an owner gets the per-device key without the vendor cloud; GATT UUIDs unpublished. A lock: unlock stays advanced. mycoolman-mcmr-fridge myCOOLMAN MCMR compressor fridges (MCMR43 confirmed). Risk C. mycoolman-ha (MIT, 2026-07). UUIDs and frame layout live only in code; voltage scaling unverified; check the Alpicool family first. fermob-linkio-lamps Fermob Hoopik / MOOON! lamps on the Linkio BLE stack. Risk C. ha-fermob (MIT, 2026-05). The handshake is undocumented; other Linkio brands may share the spec. roca-inwash-toilet Roca In-Wash shower toilets. Risk C. roca-inwash-ha (MIT, 2026-08): service fabaee02-…, AES challenge keyed by a vendor constant XOR the MAC. The vendor constant is a secret and stays out of the repo; models and firmware coverage. delonghi-pinguino-ble-remote De'Longhi Pinguino ACs whose remote is a BLE HID peripheral. Risk C. pinguino-ha-remote (MIT, 2026-06): an nRF52840 emulates the remote through the AC's SMP pairing gate. Inverted shape: the AC is the central. The schema has no block for a peripheral we emulate; propose one before a spec. senec-home-v3 SENEC.Home V2.1 / V3 batteries; EnBW is winding down SENEC sales. Risk B. pysenec, pysenechome, ioBroker.senec, evcc: unauthenticated JSON POST to /lala.cgi, fl_ hex IEEE-754 values. Read-only by rule; some firmware dropped daily statistics or answers 405; V4 / Home 4 have no local API at all. lexie-eargo-hearing-aids LXE Hearing wind-down: Lexie app and cloud off 2026-10-08, Eargo 2026-10-22 (BBB record, HearingTracker). Risk A. None. Most time-critical item in the repo: captures need a phone that still has the v9 app installed, signed in and synced. A follow-up pass the next day established that the cloud sits in front of the Lexie app's sign-in, not the BLE link, and that Eargo 5-8 aids have no radio at all (control is ultrasonic audio from the phone; BLE reaches only the charger). Medical device; settings within the fitting range only. ampler-ebike Ampler Bikes OÜ bankrupt ~2026-05-15. Risk A. None. Own drive electronics, so no existing drive spec applies; collect the APK while it is listed.

docs.text:

The first scheduled sweep. Both 2026-10-11 passes had merged, so the backlog was re-read against main before picking.

docs.title: Added this week
docs.text:
Three more of the survey's Do these next picks, all LAN hubs, one of them a graduated research note. Every spec is testing: untested; wire facts from client code are reported.

Spec Survey item Notes IKEA TRÅDFRI Gateway (E1526) #19 CoAP over DTLS-PSK on UDP 5684: mDNS _coap._udp, PSK enrolment with the label security code (/15011/9063), and the resource and key numbers for lights, outlets, blinds, groups and scenes, plus observe. Reboot and factory reset are advanced. Follows pytradfri and node-tradfri-client, which agree on paths and key numbers. Open: the DTLS cipher suite, the PSK idle-expiry rule and the blind stop value (the two clients send different values). scripts/test_ikea_tradfri_gateway_spec.py. Hörmann BiSecur Gateway #6 UDP 4001 discovery, then hex-ASCII frames on TCP 4000 with a packet checksum and a transport checksum. The rule reproduces all 30 frames in halacs/BiSecur's tests, and every example in the spec was rebuilt from it with a placeholder MAC and an invented token. Scope is login, door list, position and status, and the impulse. The impulse is advanced and carries a safety_advisory. SEC Consult's 2020 finding (clear-text logins, takeover of a session from the LAN) is the security_advisory. User, port and Wi-Fi management are left out, and so is a door button entity, which the schema cannot bind to a port from the groups list. scripts/test_hormann_bisecur_gateway_spec.py. Insteon Hub (2245-222 / 2242-222) #22, graduated from research-notes/insteon-hub.* Hub v2: HTTP on 25105 with the label's Basic auth, the send / buffer-read / buffer-clear endpoints and the 200-character ring buffer's read rules. Hub v1: raw modem frames on TCP 9761. Standard and extended frames, with the extended-message checksum, cmd1 values, link-database walk and linking. IM reset is advanced. No per-device light or switch entities: the hub's children come from a link-database walk, which instances cannot express. The Talos 2018 advisories on firmware 1012 are the security_advisory. Insteon Technologies still sells the 2245-222 (2026-10-18). The research note stays as the dated trail. scripts/test_insteon_hub_spec.py.

Corrections to the survey's rows, found while writing them:

  • TRÅDFRI. IKEA did not stop updating the gateway in July 2024. Its FAQ says no new products or features after April 2024, because the gateway hit its memory limit, and promises support at least until June 2026. Gateway firmware kept coming after that: 1.21.44 (2025-07-01), 1.21.51 (2026-02-10) and 1.21.57 (2026-05-04), which IKEA's update feed still offered on 2026-10-18. July 2024 matches only bulb-firmware releases.
  • BiSecur. No Hörmann source dates the end of support. "End of 2023 / beginning of 2024" comes from halacs's README and nothing is cited behind it. A dealer says the gateway has not been sold since December 2020, and users saw an in-app change-over notice in October 2023.

Schema gaps that came up: udp_broadcast.response_format has no XML value (BiSecur's discovery reply). No command envelope fits a hex-ASCII frame with two checksums (BiSecur) or raw binary over TCP (Insteon v1). And no instances shape fits a collection that returns a bare array of ids (TRÅDFRI). Each spec notes its gap in remaining_unknowns.

docs.text:
Device Status Risk Local path Public work Catch Withings Body+ scale (and likely other Withings scales) New paywall. Accounts created on or after 2026-10-13 need Withings+ (US$99.50/yr) for automatic sync to Apple Health, Health Connect and any third-party app, the developer API included. Nothing else qualifies. Sony's mocopi link app (leaves the stores 2026-10-28) and Casio's GSW SYSTEM app (support ends 2026-10-31) are under No local path.

docs.title: New candidates — new or popular, with a local path
docs.text:
Device Status Risk Local path Public work Catch Keto-Mojo GK+ glucose and ketone meter New HACS integration announced 2026-10-17 (HA community). Vendor active. C Phone-direct BLE on a vendor service 0003cdd0-0000-1000-8000-00805f9b0131 (not the SIG Glucose 0x1808). Commands go to cdd2 and replies come on cdd1: unit, serial and all stored records as 9-byte records (time, value, meal flag, meal type). Control-solution results are flagged. One connection at a time. No pairing step is described. ha-keto-mojo (MIT; README says it was worked out independently and contains no vendor code) Read-only and small, so a clean first spec. It is a medical device, so add a safety_advisory. Tested on one meter in mg/dL only. Frame bytes are only in the code. Easee wall chargers (Charge Max tested; others claimed) Community BLE integration first posted 2026-09-13, still active on 2026-10-07 (HA community). The company is stable: new majority owner May 2026 and back in profit. C Phone-direct BLE with a PIN handshake. The PIN is on the label, not the app password. Errors are named JPakeError, which suggests J-PAKE (unverified). State, Config and Debug channels. Writes cover current limits, phase mode (1/auto/3), cable lock, LED, reboot and local RFID keys. One BLE connection; the charger must be advertising ("always on", or a 5 s button press). ha-easee-ble and easee-ble (both MIT) No protocol doc; everything is in code. Current and phase writes need advanced plus a wiring-limit safety_advisory. Settings sync both ways with the cloud. Very large European installed base. Bluetooth SIG Mesh lights and plugs (generic; tested on a Tuya tunable-white bulb) New HACS integration posted 2026-10-15 (HA community). C Standard SIG Mesh through a GATT proxy node: provisioning (no-OOB only), Generic OnOff, Light Lightness and Light CTL. ha-aoi-sig-mesh (MIT, forked from tuya-ble-mesh, MIT) The Bluetooth SIG publishes the protocol: a profile-style spec (like bthome-v2 / matter-device) that links to it, not a reverse-engineering effort. Covers the many no-name Tuya "BLE mesh" devices. Telink proprietary mesh (survey #13, AwoX) is a separate protocol. Network keys must be placeholdered.

Considered and left out: hlmblue / helium-air-ble (a BLE air conditioner whose brand the README does not name; GPL-3.0, 0 stars, control blocked on a per-unit passkey). Thin until the brand is known.

docs.title: Status changes to items already listed
docs.text:
• Orbit B-hyve (survey row): a new, broader MIT integration was announced on 2026-10-10 (HA community; orbit-bhyve-ble, 125 commits). It actuates HT25, HT25G2 and HT25A (Gen2, verified 2026-09-14), HT31 and HT32A, and decodes HT34A; some families use protobuf. AES-128-ECB keystream with a sum(plaintext)+magic+len trailer. The per-mesh key is fetched from the cloud once, at setup. This makes the survey's "one 12-star repo" caveat out of date and makes B-hyve a stronger spec pick.
  • Lexie / Eargo: Eargo's app removal and cloud deactivation on 2026-10-22 still stands (BBB), four days from now. No source confirms that the Lexie removal on 2026-10-08 happened (unverified). Nothing new on the protocol.
  • Tesla Powerwall: pypowerwall (MIT) now says that from firmware 25.10.0 Tesla no longer supports routed access to the TEDAPI endpoint at the gateway's fixed address, so a client must join the gateway's own Wi-Fi AP (pypowerwall). The README gives no date for this. It matches the 2026-09-17 Powerwall 3 report and is not new this week.
  • Senec: this adds detail to the existing target, not news from this week. New-customer business stopped 2026-07-14, E4/P4 orders closed end of August 2026, and installs must be done by 2026-12-31. Service and warranties continue. The article says nothing about the app or cloud (pv magazine, 2026-07-14).
  • Samsung SmartThings: no source yet confirms that billing actually started in October. The latest coverage is from June.
  • TiVo SkipMode: no change. It still ends 2026-11-02, and the price of Premium Auto Commercial Skip is unpublished (Cord Cutters News).
